evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（PMID 35648332，摘要）：“ANO10, which is the main focus of the present review, exhibits both scrambling and chloride channel activity; calcium availability is necessary for protein activation in either case.”〔译：ANO10 兼具翻转酶活性与氯通道活性；两种情况下蛋白激活都需要钙离子参与。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（PMID 41229449（SCA10 机制研究：“Spinocerebellar ataxia type 10 (SCA10) is an autosomal-dominant disorder caused by intronic expansions of pentanucleotide repeats in the ATXN10 gene.”）〔译：SCA10 是常染色体显性遗传病，由 ATXN10 基因内含子区的五核苷酸重复扩展引起（非编码区重复 → RNA 毒性机制）。〕；补证 RNA 毒性：PMID 20548952：“A Cy3-(AGAAU)(10) riboprobe detected expanded AUUCU repeats aggregated in foci in SCA10 cells… expanded AUUCU repeats within the spliced intronic sequence strongly bind to hnRNP K”；该文并述“neither a gain nor a loss of function of ataxin 10 is likely the major pathogenic mechanism of SCA10”，支持 RNA 毒性为主导机制。〔译：原位杂交见扩增的 AUUCU 重复在 SCA10 细胞中聚集成焦点；扩增的 AUUCU 重复与 hnRNP K 强结合；ataxin-10 的功能获得或丧失均非主要致病机制。〕）
evidence_path_h: path·PC_loss（PMID 23813740，摘要）：“Purkinje cell loss is the major brain pathology of spinocerebellar ataxia type 10.”〔译：浦肯野细胞丢失是 SCA10 的主要脑部病理改变。〕 ；path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 35441258（SCA10 中国汉族队列，5 例有影像：“Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) showed cerebellar atrophy in five patients with available data.”；另 PMID 11506407（4 个墨西哥家系）：“Brain magnetic resonance imaging showed predominant cerebellar atrophy, and nerve conduction studies indicated polyneuropathy in 66% of patients.”）〔译：MRI 显示 5 例有影像资料的患者存在小脑萎缩；4 个墨西哥家系的脑 MRI 以 小脑萎缩 为主，66% 患者神经传导检查提示多发性周围神经病。〕；另 PMID 41995906（巴西 SCA10 队列 20 例）：“In the SCA10 group, 16 patients presented with mild cerebellar atrophy”〔译：SCA10 组 20 例中 16 例存在轻度小脑萎缩〕）｜尸检例数核对：PMID 23813740 全文为「we report the post-mortem neuropathologic findings of an SCA10 patient and compare these to a normal age and gender-matched control subject」「This is the first neuropathological description of an SCA10 patient」——人脑组织仅 1 例（另 1 例为正常对照）；原文未把 MRI 队列计入尸检

T-type calcium channels belong to the 'low-voltage activated (LVA)' group and are strongly blocked by mibefradil."〔译：α-1G 亚型产生 T 型钙电流；T 型钙通道属于“低电压激活（LVA）”组，可被米贝地尔强烈阻断。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（PMID 37752213，摘要）：“Transcript analysis of the splice site variant revealed activation of a novel cryptic splice acceptor site on exon 13 resulting in an alternative transcription with a loss of nine nucleotide…”〔译：对该剪接位点变异作转录本分析，发现激活了外显子 13 上一个新的隐蔽剪接受体位点，产生缺失 9 个核苷酸的异常转录本。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 37752213，摘要）：“Cerebellar atrophy, and T2/FLAIR hypointense transverse pontine stripes were observed in brain imaging.”〔译：脑影像可见小脑萎缩及脑桥横行 T2/FLAIR 低信号条纹。〕 ；path·cerebellar_hypoplasia（PMID 37752213｜CWF19L1-SCAR17.pdf p.2）：“MRI brain images show hypoplastic cerebellum with altered T2/FLAIR intensity in midbrain, pons, and middle cerebellar peduncles in Patient-1 and atrophy of cerebellum, pons and middle cerebellar peduncles in Patient-2.”〔译：MRI 脑影像显示患者 1 小脑发育不良，伴中脑、脑桥与小脑中脚 T2/FLAIR 信号异常；患者 2 则为小脑、脑桥与小脑中脚萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 42310195，摘要）：“Cerebrotendinous xanthomatosis (CTX) is rare, autosomal recessive inborn error of metabolism caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in CYP27A1, which encodes sterile 27 hydroxylase [sic]，注：原摘要如此；正确写法为 sterol 27-hydroxylase， a key enzyme in bile acid biosynthesis.”〔译：CTX 是罕见的常染色体隐性遗传代谢病，由 CYP27A1 双等位致病变异引起；该基因编码固醇 27-羟化酶，为胆汁酸合成的关键酶。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·other（PMID 40314981，摘要）：“Stop-loss in ITM2B/BRI2 results in C-terminal extension of the encoded protein and, upon furin cleavage, in the production of two 34 amino acid long peptides, ADan and ABri, that accumulate as amyloids in the brains of patients affected by familial Danish and British Dementia.”〔译：ITM2B/BRI2 的无终止密码子突变（stop-loss）使所编码蛋白 C 端延长，经弗林蛋白酶切割后产生两种 34 个氨基酸的肽 ADan 与 ABri，在家族性丹麦型与英国型痴呆患者脑内以淀粉样物质沉积。〕；蛋白正常功能背景（UniProt Q9Y287，Function）："Plays a regulatory role in the processing of the amyloid-beta A4 precursor protein (APP) and acts as an inhibitor of amyloid-beta peptide aggregation and fibril deposition."〔译：调控淀粉样前体蛋白（APP）的加工，并抑制淀粉样肽聚集与纤维沉积。〕；mech=proteostasis_RNA (PMID 10391242, Abstract): "Release of the 34 carboxy-terminal amino acids from the mutated precursor generates the ABri amyloid subunit." [译：突变型 BRI2 前体经切割释放 C 端 34 个氨基酸，形成具有淀粉样蛋白形成能力的ABri肽。]
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 39625954，台湾队列 3 先证者+3 患病亲属，全文）：“Magnetic resonance imaging and spectroscopy revealed progressive extension of white matter hyperintensity over periventricular and subcortical regions, subtle hippocampal atrophy, preserved cerebellar volumes, and decreased N-acetylaspartate/creatine ratio over the vermis.”〔译：MRI 与 MRS 显示白质高信号由脑室周围向皮质下进行性扩展，海马轻度萎缩，小脑体积保留，蚓部 NAA/肌酸比值下降。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt Q5T2R2，Function）："Heterotetrameric enzyme that catalyzes the condensation of farnesyl diphosphate (FPP), which acts as a primer, and isopentenyl diphosphate (IPP) to produce prenyl diphosphates of varying chain lengths and participates in the determination of the side chain of ubiquinone."〔译：异四聚体酶，催化法尼基二磷酸（FPP，引物）与异戊烯基二磷酸（IPP）缩合生成不同链长的戊烯基二磷酸，参与决定泛醌的侧链长度。〕；疾病背景（PMID 33285023，摘要）："The visual system seems to be mainly involved when the first steps of CoQ10 synthesis are impaired (PDSS1, PDSS2, and COQ2 deficiency)."〔译：当 CoQ10 合成的起始步骤受损时（PDSS1、PDSS2 与 COQ2 缺陷），视觉系统似乎主要受累。〕〔注：疾病背景句为多基因表型描述，不作 K 分箱主证。〕
evidence_path_h: path·retina（PMID 36266294，Results，全文）：“Subsequent genome-wide analysis identified candidate biallelic variants in CoQ10 biosynthesis pathway genes in 13 affected individuals with a clinical diagnosis of retinitis pigmentosa (RP) from 12 unrelated families”〔译：后续全基因组分析在来自 12 个无关家系、临床诊断为视网膜色素变性（RP）的 13 例受累个体中，鉴定出 CoQ10 生物合成通路基因的候选双等位变异。〕；另（同文/同章）：“Biallelic variants were identified in PDSS1 (6 families, 6 affected individuals), COQ2 (3 families, 4 affected individuals), COQ4 (1 family, 1 affected individual) and COQ5 (2 families, 2 affected individuals) genes”〔译：双等位变异见于 PDSS1（6 家系 6 例）、COQ2（3 家系 4 例）、COQ4（1 家系 1 例）与 COQ5（2 家系 2 例）基因。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（NCBI Gene 57107（PDSS2），Summary/RefSeq）："The protein encoded by this gene is an enzyme that synthesizes the prenyl side-chain of coenzyme Q, or ubiquinone, one of the key elements in the respiratory chain."〔译：本基因编码的蛋白是催化辅酶 Q（泛醌）戊烯基侧链合成的酶，泛醌是呼吸链的关键组分之一。〕；同节："The gene product catalyzes the formation of all trans-polyprenyl pyrophosphates from isopentyl diphosphate in the assembly of polyisoprenoid side chains, the first step in coenzyme Q biosynthesis."〔译：基因产物以异戊烯基二磷酸为原料催化全反式多戊烯基焦磷酸的生成，属多戊烯基侧链组装、辅酶 Q 生物合成的第一步。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（UniProt O00555，Function）："The isoform alpha-1A gives rise to P and/or Q-type calcium currents."〔译：α1A 剪接体产生 P/Q 型钙电流——CACNA1A 正常通道功能。〕；疾病背景（PMID 42377810，摘要）："Episodic ataxia type 2 (EA2) is an autosomal dominant channelopathy caused by CACNA1A mutations, typically presenting with recurrent episodes of ataxia, vertigo, and hemiplegic migraine, often with a normal brain MRI or cerebellar atrophy."〔译：EA2 是 CACNA1A 突变所致常染色体显性通道病——背景句，不作证据主句。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 37165528（CACNA1A 分子确诊 EA2，10 名患者/5 个家系），Results，摘要）："50% of patients with neuroimaging presented cerebellar atrophy."〔译：有影像资料的患者中 50% 出现小脑萎缩。〕〔注：原引 PMID 42377810 的「often with a normal brain MRI or cerebellar atrophy」为 EA2 通用背景句，非该例实测影像，不能作 A 级主证——已更换。分母=有影像资料者，不得写成 5/10 全体患者。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（更换证据。原引 PMID 20301562 讲的是“可用偏头痛预防性药物”，属治疗建议，不构成机制证据）：PMID 35238776：“knock-in mice carrying the severer S218L or milder R192Q FHM1 gain-of-function missense mutation in the CACNA1A gene that encodes the α1A subunit of neuronal voltage-gated CaV2.1 (P/Q-type) calcium channels”〔译：FHM1 的 S218L（较重）与 R192Q（较轻）为 CACNA1A 基因的功能获得性错义突变；该基因编码神经元电压门控 CaV2.1（P/Q 型）钙通道的 α1A 亚基。〕另 PMID 40906262（2025）：“These CaV2.1 channelopathies are typically caused by either channel loss/reduction-of-function (LOF) or gain-of-function (GOF)”〔译：CaV2.1 通道病通常由功能缺失/功能降低或功能获得所致。〕注：上述功能获得证据来自 knock-in 小鼠与体外电生理，且不同 FHM1 等位基因的实验结果并不完全一致，故本行 mutation_class 仍保守记为 missense，未改 missense_GoF_DN。〔机制证据模型：CACNA1A 敲入小鼠，非人源直接证据〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（Bookshelf_NBK1388.pdf p.5）：“The only abnormalities observed on traditional imaging studies are vermian cerebellar atrophy in some families with CACNA1A-FHM”〔译：传统影像学检查所见的唯一异常，是部分 CACNA1A-FHM 家系中的蚓部小脑萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（UniProt O00305，Function）："The beta subunit of voltage-dependent calcium channels contributes to the function of the calcium channel by increasing peak calcium current, shifting the voltage dependencies of activation and inactivation, modulating G protein inhibition and controlling the alpha-1 subunit membrane targeting."〔译：电压依赖钙通道 β 亚基通过增大峰值钙电流、移动激活/失活电压依赖性、调节 G 蛋白抑制及控制 α1 亚基膜靶向，参与通道功能——明确 CACNB4 的 β4 辅助亚基身份。〕；背景（原引 PMID 32176688）："P/Q-type channels are the principal presynaptic calcium channels in brain functioning in neurotransmitter release."〔译：P/Q 型通道是脑内介导神经递质释放的主要突触前钙通道。〕

mech·cilia_congenital_dev（UniProt Q9Y6Y1，Function）："Transcriptional activator."〔译：转录激活因子。〕；人 CAMTA1 转录激活功能的结果句（PMID 11925432，摘要）："Two human proteins designated HsCAMTA1 and HsCAMTA2 were also shown to activate transcription in yeast using the same reporter system."〔译：两个人类蛋白 HsCAMTA1 与 HsCAMTA2 亦被证明在酵母中用同一报告系统激活转录。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕〔另注：任务书所给 Q9BW60 实为其他条目，CAMTA1 正确 accession 为 Q9Y6Y1。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 26848311，摘要）：“The yet reported patients affected by mono-allelic CAMTA1 dysfunction presented with neonatal hypotonia, delayed and ataxic gait, cerebellar atrophy, psychological delay and speech impairment, while individuals carrying a disrupted NFIA allele suffered from agenesis/hypoplasia of the corpus callosum, ventriculomegaly,…”〔译：已报道的单等位 CAMTA1 功能丧失患者表现为新生儿肌张力低下、行走延迟且呈共济失调步态、小脑萎缩、精神发育迟滞与言语障碍。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（PMID 37190086；PMC10136522 Introduction，全文）：“At the presynaptic terminal, CASK functions as a hub for the Neurexin complex.”〔译：在突触前终末，CASK 作为 Neurexin 复合物的枢纽发挥作用。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_hypoplasia（PMID 22452838（CASK 突变 13 例患儿队列），Discussion，全文）：“Finally, all girls and boys with inactivating CASK mutations presented with a recognizable phenotype characterized by severe postnatal microcephaly, moderate to severe motor and intellectual disability, feeding and sleep difficulties, frequent ophthalmological anomalies and PCH on MRI.”〔译：最后，所有失活 CASK 突变的女童与男童均呈现可识别的表型，特征为重度出生后小头、中重度运动与智力障碍、喂养与睡眠困难、 frequent 眼科异常，且 MRI 上有脑桥小脑发育不良（PCH）。〕；另（同文/同章）：“Furthermore, analysis of the MRI gives additional clues showing relative sparing of the pons, asymmetry of the cerebellar hemispheres as well as vermian and cerebellar involvement.”〔译：此外，MRI 分析提供了更多线索：脑桥相对保留、小脑半球不对称以及蚓部和小脑受累。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 CC2D2A—JBTS9）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。。【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕；基因特异功能（UniProt Q9P2K1，Function）："Component of the tectonic-like complex, a complex localized at the transition zone of primary cilia and acting as a barrier that prevents diffusion of transmembrane proteins between the cilia and plasma membranes. Required for ciliogenesis and sonic hedgehog/SHH signaling (By similarity)."〔译：纤毛过渡区类 tectonic 复合体组分，该复合体在初级纤毛过渡区起屏障作用，阻止跨膜蛋白在纤毛膜与质膜间扩散；为纤毛发生与 sonic hedgehog/SHH 信号所必需。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.15）：“When detection of cerebellar vermis hypoplasia by routine prenatal ultrasound examination raises the possibility of JS, fetal MRI may detect the typical molar tooth sign (MTS);”〔译：当常规产前超声检查发现小脑蚓部发育不良、提示 Joubert 综合征可能时，胎儿 MRI 可检出典型的磨牙征（MTS）。〕path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 18950740，Gorden 2008 AJHG，CC2D2A 首报，全文图 1/图 4 图注）：“(A and B) Sagittal (A) and axial (B) MRI images of subject UW50 VI:3 revealing cerebellar vermis hypoplasia (arrowhead) and thick horizontally oriented superior cerebellar peduncles (arrow).”〔译：UW50 VI:3 受试者的矢状位与轴位 MRI 见小脑蚓部发育不良（箭头）及增粗且水平走行的小脑上脚（箭）。〕；图 4 图注（UW46 II:1、UW46 II:2、UW47 II:1、UW41 II:1 及 Noor 等 36 号受试者 5 名个体）：“revealing cerebellar vermis hypoplasia (arrowhead) and thick, horizontally oriented superior cerebellar peduncles (arrows).”〔译：见小脑蚓部发育不良（箭头）与增粗、水平走行的小脑上脚（箭）。〕path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 18950740，Gorden 2008 AJHG，正文）：“we reviewed the brain MRI images from two of the affected individuals with homozygous CC2D2A mutations described by Noor et al., 22 and we identified the characteristic imaging features of Joubert syndrome in both subjects”〔译：我们复习了 Noor 等报道的 2 名纯合 CC2D2A 突变受累个体的脑 MRI，两例均确认具备 Joubert 综合征的典型影像特征。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·other（UniProt Q9P219，Function）："Required for activation of guanine nucleotide-binding proteins (G proteins) during non-canonical Wnt signaling. Binds to ligand-activated Wnt receptor FZD7, displacing DVL1 from the FZD7 receptor and leading to inhibition of canonical Wnt signaling."〔译：在非经典 Wnt 信号中激活 G 蛋白所必需；结合配体激活的 Wnt 受体 FZD7、置换 DVL1 并抑制经典 Wnt 信号——野生型 CCDC88C/DAPLE 正常功能。〕；突变致病实验另记（PMID 25062847，摘要）："Functional studies showed that the mutant form of CCDC88C activates the c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK) pathway, induces caspase 3 cleavage and triggers apoptosis."〔译：突变型 CCDC88C 激活 JNK 通路、诱导 caspase 3 剪切与凋亡——属突变体功能实验（致病机制补充），不作 K 正常功能。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 25062847，SCA40 原始家系：“an autosomal-dominant SCA phenotype in a family that exhibits cerebellar ataxia and pontocerebellar atrophy along with a global reduction in brain volume”；另 PMID 34436841（中国家系）：“Magnetic resonance imaging showed varying degrees of cerebellar atrophy.”）〔译：一个家系呈常染色体显性 SCA 表型，表现为小脑共济失调与脑桥小脑萎缩，伴全脑体积普遍缩小；中国家系 MRI 显示不同程度的小脑萎缩。〕

Its association with CCP110 is required for inhibition of primary cilia formation by CCP110 (PubMed:18694559)."〔译：参与纤毛形成的早期与晚期步骤；其与 CCP110 的结合是 CCP110 抑制初级纤毛形成所必需。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.15）：“When detection of cerebellar vermis hypoplasia by routine prenatal ultrasound examination raises the possibility of JS, fetal MRI may detect the typical molar tooth sign (MTS);”〔译：当常规产前超声检查发现小脑蚓部发育不良、提示 Joubert 综合征可能时，胎儿 MRI 可检出典型的磨牙征（MTS）。〕path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 42271513，Hum Genomics 2026，CEP290 纯合剪接变异家系 2 名患者，全文）：“Brain MRI (axial view) revealed a molar tooth sign (MTS) characterized by cerebellar vermis hypoplasia, thick and maloriented superior cerebellar peduncles, and abnormally deep interpeduncular fossa.”〔译：先证者（V.2，11 岁）脑 MRI（轴位）显示典型磨牙征：小脑蚓部发育不良、小脑上脚增粗且方向异常、脚间窝异常加深。〕；“She also presented with blindness, an inability to walk, intellectual disability, and the MTS with cerebral cortex atrophy on brain MRI (Fig. 1 C, lower).”〔译：其 5 岁妹妹同样表现为失明、不能行走、智力障碍，脑 MRI 见磨牙征伴大脑皮质萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 42074169；PMC13116151，全文）：“The COQ8A gene, also known as ADCK3 or CABC1 , encodes an atypical protein kinase that stabilises the multi-protein CoQ synthesis complex.”〔译：COQ8A 基因（又称 ADCK3 或 CABC1）编码一种非典型蛋白激酶，可稳定多蛋白 CoQ 合成复合物。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 42074169；PMC13116151，全文）：“Q-syndrome patients with mutations in this gene typically develop childhood-onset cerebellar atrophy and ataxia and have decreased CoQ10 content in their muscle, fibroblast, and lymphoblast cells.”〔译：伴该基因突变的 Q 综合征患者通常出现儿童期起病的小脑萎缩与共济失调，其肌肉、成纤维细胞与淋巴母细胞中 CoQ10 含量降低。〕

evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.15）：“When detection of cerebellar vermis hypoplasia by routine prenatal ultrasound examination raises the possibility of JS, fetal MRI may detect the typical molar tooth sign (MTS);”〔译：当常规产前超声检查发现小脑蚓部发育不良、提示 Joubert 综合征可能时，胎儿 MRI 可检出典型的磨牙征（MTS）。〕path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 24360807，Akizu 2014 AJHG，CSPP1 纯合变异 6 名受累儿童，全文）：“The clinical phenotype of the affected children included hypotonia, developmental delay, intellectual disability, hyperpnea, and apnea episodes in the neonatal period and the MTI ( Figure 2 ).”〔译：受累儿童的临床表型包括肌张力低下、发育迟缓、智力障碍、新生儿期呼吸急促与呼吸暂停发作，以及磨牙征（MTI）。〕；图 2 图注：“Images show molar tooth sign (red circle) with elongated superior cerebellar peduncles, deepened interhemispheric fossa, and cerebellar vermis hypoplasia.”〔译：影像显示磨牙征（红圈），伴小脑上脚延长、脚间窝加深及小脑蚓部发育不良。〕path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 24360808，Tuz 2014 AJHG，CSPP1 双等位截断变异 19 名患者，全文）：“The brain MRI findings in ten individuals also displayed a wide range of severity ( Table S2 ).”〔译：10 名个体的脑 MRI 所见亦显示严重程度差异很大。〕；“Of note, UW141-4 had a subset of the imaging findings typically seen in individuals with JBTS ( Figures 1 J–1L): mild cerebellar vermis hypoplasia ( Figure 1 K) and superior cerebellar dysplasia (compare Figure 1 L to Figure 1 M) without thick, misoriented superior cerebellar peduncles ( Figures 1 J and 1K).”〔译：值得注意的是，UW141-4 具有 JBTS 患者典型影像的一部分：轻度小脑蚓部发育不良与小脑上部发育不良，但无增粗、方向异常的小脑上脚。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·other（UniProt O75553，Function）："Signaling adapter of the reelin-mediated signaling pathway, which regulates the migration and differentiation of postmitotic neurons during brain development. Mediates intracellular transduction of Reelin signaling following reelin (RELN)-binding to its receptor."〔译：Reelin 信号通路的信号适配蛋白——该通路调控脑发育中有丝分裂后神经元的迁移与分化；介导 Reelin 结合受体后的胞内信号转导。野生型 DAB1 正常功能。〕〔注：原 N 的两条致病途径（ATTTC 插入致 DAB1 增强子过激活→过表达/轴突导向异常，PMID 41871099；斑马鱼重复 RNA 毒性，PMID 41854242）移入本注——属患者来源神经元与模式动物实验，尚未定量解释成人 PC 丢失，不作 K 正常功能。〕
evidence_path_h: path·PC_loss（ GeneReviews NBK541729（SCA37，引自 Corral-Juan et al 2018）：“Postmortem neuropathology of two individuals with SCA37 showed severe loss of Purkinje cells with abundant astrogliosis, empty baskets, occasional axonal spheroids … in the cerebellar cortex.”〔译：2 例 SCA37 患者的尸检神经病理显示小脑皮质浦肯野细胞严重丢失，伴大量星形胶质增生、空篮细胞及偶见轴索球样变。〕）

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（UniProt P13639，Function）："Catalyzes the GTP-dependent ribosomal translocation step during translation elongation."〔译：在翻译延伸中催化依赖 GTP 的核糖体转位步骤——野生型人 eEF2 正常功能。〕；致病模型另记（PMID 23001565，摘要）："The yeast equivalent, P580H EF2, demonstrated impaired translocation, detected as an increased rate of -1 programmed ribosomal frameshift read-through in a dual-luciferase assay for observing translational recoding."〔译：酵母同源物 P580H EF2 示转位受损、-1 移码通读率升高——属酵母模型实验（对应人类 p.Pro596His），不作 K 正常功能主证。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 15732118，Yu et al. 2005 Ann Neurol）：“A total of 11 affected members were studied by brain MRI scan, including two who were not examined but were found to have cerebellar atrophy by MRI scan.”；图 2 注：“Prominent cerebellar atrophy is present with sparing of brainstem.”〔译：11 名患病成员接受脑 MRI 检查，其中 2 例经影像发现小脑萎缩；图中见明显小脑萎缩、脑干未受累。〕 ；path·PC_loss（PMID 23001565；dds392.pdf p.2，「Results」）：“Both individuals had a significant loss of Purkinje cells with minimal or no neuronal loss in other brain regions (Fig. 1).”〔译：两名患者均见浦肯野细胞显著丢失，其他脑区神经元丢失轻微或缺如。〕〔模态：尸检；物种：人；n=2〕path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 15732118，Yu 2005 Ann Neurol，摘要）：“We studied a six-generation kindred of Norwegian ancestry with pure cerebellar ataxia inherited in an autosomal dominant pattern.”〔译：我们研究了一个挪威裔六代家系，呈常染色体显性遗传的纯小脑共济失调。〕；“Brain magnetic resonance imaging study of 11 affected patients showed that atrophy was confined to the cerebellum.”〔译：对 11 名受累患者的脑 MRI 研究显示萎缩局限于小脑。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 41495266，摘要）：“Fatty acid elongase 4 (Elovl4) is a crucial enzyme in mammals for synthesizing very long-chain fatty acids (VLC-FAs) with more than 26 carbons in a few specific tissues.”〔译：脂肪酸延长酶 4（Elovl4）是哺乳动物体内在少数特定组织中合成碳链长于 26 的极长链脂肪酸（VLC-FA）的关键酶。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 36696030，摘要）：“For brain MRI data, cerebellar atrophy was seen in all cases (100%), whereas the hot cross bun sign (typically associated with multiple system atrophy type C) was seen in 32.4% of cases.”〔译：脑 MRI 数据显示全部病例（100%）均见小脑萎缩；而“十字面包征”（通常与多系统萎缩 C 型相关）见于 32.4% 的病例。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic PMID 40789653（SCA38/ELOVL5 研究）：“Elovl5 is crucial for the elongation of polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFAs) beyond 18-carbon atoms, and its deletion or mutation causes cerebellar motor deficits in humans and mice.”〔译：Elovl5 对 18 碳以上多不饱和脂肪酸的延长至关重要，其缺失或突变可在人与小鼠中引起小脑运动障碍。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 27143115（SCA38 临床与神经影像系列，20 例），Results – Neuroimaging features，全文）：“Brain MRI showed mild cerebellar atrophy mainly affecting the vermis, with normal brainstem and no cerebral cortex atrophy.”〔译：脑 MRI 显示以蚓部为主的轻度小脑萎缩，脑干正常、无大脑皮质萎缩。〕；另（同文/同章）：“As reported in Supplementary Table, visual rating of the available MRI scans over the course of the disease (14 patients evaluated over time with 25 MRI scans available) confirmed selective cerebellar atrophy with spared brainstem and cerebral cortex in almost all cases.”〔译：如补充表所示，对病程中可用 MRI 的视觉评分（14 例患者纵向评估、共 25 次 MRI）证实几乎所有病例为选择性小脑萎缩，脑干与大脑皮质保留。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（PMID 25926453（Bosch 2015 J Neurosci，iFGF14–Nav 通道调控原始文献），摘要）："Further experiments revealed that the loss of iFGF14 results in a marked hyperpolarizing shift in the voltage dependence of steady-state inactivation of the Nav currents in adult Purkinje neurons."〔译：iFGF14 缺失使成年浦肯野神经元 Nav 电流稳态失活的电压依赖性发生显著超极化偏移——FGF14 直接调控 Nav 通道可用性的正常功能证据。〕；致病方式另记（PMID 38279833）："spinocerebellar ataxia 27B (SCA27B) caused by a (GAA)•(TTC) repeat expansion in intron 1 of the fibroblast growth factor 14 (FGF14) gene."〔译：SCA27B 由 FGF14 内含子 1 (GAA)•(TTC) 重复扩展引起——属致病变异类别（J=repeat_noncoding），不作 K 功能证据。〕〔注：SCA27A（编码区错义）与 SCA27B（GAA 扩增）机制证据不混用。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 42090775（SCA27B 队列 21 例）：“Neuroimaging showed cerebellar atrophy in 7/21”；另 PMID 42096001：“Cerebellar atrophy was present in 45% of patients with available MRI.”）〔译：神经影像显示 21 例中 7 例存在小脑萎缩；有 MRI 资料的患者中 45% 存在小脑萎缩。〕
review_status: 有登记资源，待逐队列质控

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（PMID 25926453（Bosch 2015 J Neurosci，浦肯野细胞 Nav 电流实验原始文献），摘要）："Further experiments revealed that the loss of iFGF14 results in a marked hyperpolarizing shift in the voltage dependence of steady-state inactivation of the Nav currents in adult Purkinje neurons."〔译：进一步实验显示，iFGF14 缺失使成年浦肯野神经元 Nav 电流稳态失活的电压依赖性发生显著的超极化方向偏移。〕；既往结果在 2025 年研究的转述（PMID 40323232，摘要）："we have previously shown that the deficits in motor coordination reflect reduced excitability of cerebellar Purkinje neurons, owing to a hyperpolarizing shift in the voltage-dependence of voltage-gated Na+ (Nav) current steady-state inactivation."〔译：我们此前已证明，运动协调缺陷源于小脑浦肯野神经元兴奋性降低，机制为电压门控 Na+（Nav）电流稳态失活的电压依赖性向超极化方向偏移。〕；PMID 40323232（2025 JGP）本研究新数据为海马 CA1（非浦肯野），结果句："Current-clamp recordings from CA1 pyramidal neurons in acute in vitro slices, however, revealed that evoked repetitive firing rates were higher in Fgf14-/- than in wild type (WT) cells."〔译：然而，急性离体切片 CA1 锥体神经元的电流钳记录显示，Fgf14-/- 细胞的诱发重复放电频率高于野生型细胞。〕〔注：浦肯野 Nav 机制出自 2015 原始研究；2025 文献的贡献在 CA1，二者不混用。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 29416937（SCA27 文献综述，汇总 32 例，其中 20 例有 MRI 资料）：“20% (four out of 20) of the SCA27 patients with MRI information were reported to have abnormal MRI with evidence of cerebellar atrophy.” —— 仅 20%，非主要表现）〔译：有 MRI 资料的 20 例 SCA27 患者中，20%（4 例）报告异常 MRI 并有小脑萎缩证据。仅 20%，非主要表现。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（UniProt Q06787，Function）："Multifunctional polyribosome-associated RNA-binding protein that plays a central role in neuronal development and synaptic plasticity through the regulation of alternative mRNA splicing, mRNA stability, mRNA dendritic transport and postsynaptic local protein synthesis of target mRNAs."〔译：多功能的核糖体相关 RNA 结合蛋白——通过调控可变剪接、mRNA 稳定性、mRNA 树突转运与靶 mRNA 的突触后局部翻译，在神经元发育与突触可塑性中起核心作用。野生型 FMRP 正常功能。〕；mech·proteostasis_RNA（更换证据。原引 PMID 42324051 讲的是 FMRP 调控 mRNA 翻译、即全突变所致脆性 X 综合征（FXS）的机制，与本行 FXTAS（前突变）不符，属机制错配）：PMID 41717020（2026，FXTAS 机制研究）：“Fragile X-associated tremor/ataxia syndrome (FXTAS) is caused by CGG repeat expansions in FMR1, leading to RNA toxicity and toxic FMRpolyG peptide from abnormal translation.”〔译：FXTAS 由 FMR1 的 CGG 重复扩增引起，通过 RNA 毒性以及异常翻译产生的毒性 FMRpolyG 肽致病。〕；另 PMID 42301916（2026）：“Repeat-associated non-AUG (RAN) translation of mutant FMR1 messenger RNA containing CGG repeat expansions results in the production of a toxic polyglycine protein (FMRpolyG), which contributes to fragile X premutation-associated conditions (FXPAC), including fragile X-associated tremor/ataxia syndrome (FXTAS).”〔译：含 CGG 扩增的突变 FMR1 mRNA 经重复相关非 AUG（RAN）翻译产生毒性多聚甘氨酸蛋白 FMRpolyG，参与包括 FXTAS 在内的脆性 X 前突变相关疾病。〕注：proteostasis_RNA 归类不变——FXTAS 的核心是 RNA 层面的重复序列毒性（RNA foci）叠加异常翻译产物。
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 41777701，摘要）：“Bilateral hyperintensities of the middle cerebellar peduncles (MCP sign) are the major radiological hallmarks of FXTAS.”〔译：小脑中脚双侧高信号（MCP 征）是 FXTAS 的主要影像学标志。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt Q16595，Function）："Functions as an activator of persulfide transfer to the scaffolding protein ISCU as component of the core iron-sulfur cluster (ISC) assembly complex and participates to the [2Fe-2S] cluster assembly."〔译：作为核心铁硫簇（ISC）装配复合体的组分，激活向支架蛋白 ISCU 的过硫化物转移、参与 [2Fe-2S] 簇装配——野生型 frataxin 正常功能。〕；疾病模型补充：（PMID 42833467，摘要）：“FXN-KO mice also showed upregulation of mitochondrial Ca2+-handling proteins, including mitochondrial Ca2+ uniporter and voltage-dependent anion channel, depolarized Δψm, and elevated reactive oxygen species.”〔译：FXN 敲除小鼠还出现线粒体钙处理蛋白（含线粒体钙单向转运体与电压依赖性阴离子通道）上调、Δψm 去极化及活性氧升高。〕
evidence_path_h: path·DRG_sensory（PMID 23334592（Friedreich ataxia 神经病理综述；本地 annurev-pathmechdis-032025-035253.pdf）：“This review of the neuropathology of Friedreich ataxia stresses the critical role of hypoplasia and superimposed atrophy of dorsal root ganglia.”〔译：该 Friedreich 共济失调神经病理综述强调背根神经节发育不良与叠加性萎缩的核心作用。〕） ；path·spinocerebellar_tract（改挂尸检证据）：PMID 23334592（FRDA 神经病理综述）：“Progressive destruction of dorsal root ganglia accounts for thinning of dorsal roots, degeneration of dorsal columns, transsynaptic atrophy of nerve cells in Clarke column and dorsal spinocerebellar fibers…”〔译：背根神经节进行性破坏导致背根变细、后索变性、Clarke 柱神经元跨突触萎缩及背侧脊髓小脑纤维受累……〕 ；path·dorsal_column（PMID 23334592；annurev-pathmechdis-032025-035253.pdf）：“the dorsal column sensory system, involving afferents for proprioceptors and vibratory receptors”〔译：后索感觉系统，包括本体觉与振动觉传入纤维。〕〔模态：神经病理综述；物种：人；n=综述（多例尸检汇总）；同句前文述该系统为 FRDA 除小脑外最受累系统，PDF 在「af ter」处断词，故从断词后起引〕
review_status: 有登记资源，待逐队列质控

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（PMID 32622959，摘要）：“It is caused by bi-allelic aberrations in the GRID2 gene, encoding an ionotropic glutamate receptor.”〔译：该病由 GRID2 双等位基因异常引起，该基因编码离子型谷氨酸受体。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_hypoplasia【罕少病例外】（PMID 32622959，摘要）：“Brain imaging showed cerebellar hypoplasia, extended cerebrospinal fluid spaces and beginning reduction of cerebral volume.”〔译：脑影像显示小脑发育不良、脑脊液间隙扩大及大脑体积开始减小。〕注：同文“cerebellar atrophy in brain imaging”系 20 例已报道患者的疾病谱共性描述，非本例影像；本例为 4 岁女童单例，按【罕少病例外】记录。

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（UniProt Q13255，Function）："G protein-coupled receptor for glutamate. Ligand binding causes a conformational change that triggers signaling via guanine nucleotide-binding proteins (G proteins) and modulates the activity of down-stream effectors. Signaling activates a phosphatidylinositol-calcium second messenger system."〔译：谷氨酸 G 蛋白偶联受体——配体结合经 G 蛋白触发信号、激活磷酸肌醇-钙第二信使系统。野生型 mGluR1 正常受体功能。〕；亚型致病对照：（PMID 40199824，摘要）：“Its pathogenic variants are associated with the rare autosomal recessive cerebellar ataxia 13 (SCAR13) due to loss of mGluR1 function, and the even rarer spinocerebellar ataxia 44 (SCA44) due to a gain-of-function molecular basis.”〔译：其致病变异与罕见的常染色体隐性小脑共济失调 13 型（SCAR13，因 mGluR1 功能丧失）以及更罕见的脊髓小脑共济失调 44 型（SCA44，基于功能获得机制）相关。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 37831383（SCAR13/GRM1 综述）：“Cerebellar atrophy and/or ventriculomegaly may be present on brain MRI.”）〔译：脑 MRI 可见小脑萎缩和/或脑室扩大。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（UniProt Q13255，Function）："G protein-coupled receptor for glutamate. Signaling activates a phosphatidylinositol-calcium second messenger system."〔译：谷氨酸 G 蛋白偶联受体，信号激活磷酸肌醇-钙第二信使系统——野生型 mGluR1 正常功能。〕；mech·channel_synapse（PMID 39030902，摘要 Key results）："mGlu1 mutants exhibited differential impacts on mGlu1 expression, with a C-terminus truncation significantly reducing surface expression. Mutations differentially influenced orthosteric ligand affinity, efficacy and functional cooperativity between allosteric and orthosteric ligands. Loss-of-function mutations L454F and N885del reduced orthosteric affinity and efficacy, respectively."〔译：mGlu1 突变体对 mGlu1 表达呈差异化影响，其中 C 末端截断显著降低表面表达；突变对正构配体亲和力、效能及变构与正构配体间的功能性协同均产生差异化影响；功能缺失突变 L454F 与 N885del 分别降低正构亲和力与效能。〕〔注：原引为研究目的句，现替换为同文献 Key results 段结果句。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 28886343，正文与 Fig 1A）：两个成人起病家系的受累成员“Brain MRI in members of both families revealed cerebellar atrophy, with mild flattening of the pons in family 1”〔译：两家系受累成员脑 MRI 均见小脑萎缩，家系 1 伴轻度脑桥扁平。〕Fig 1A 展示 3 名影像阳性患者：家系 1 的 II:1 与 III:1、家系 2 的 II:1；家系 3 的 c.3165dup p.(Gly1056Argfs*49) 患儿“without apparent cerebellar atrophy, and normal brain imaging”〔译：无明显小脑萎缩，影像正常。〕故小脑萎缩见于错义型而非全部 SCA44 患者

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（UniProt Q9NRR6，Function）："Phosphatidylinositol (PtdIns) phosphatase that specifically hydrolyzes the 5-phosphate of phosphatidylinositol-3,4,5-trisphosphate (PtdIns(3,4,5)P3), phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PtdIns(4,5)P2) and phosphatidylinositol 3,5-bisphosphate (PtdIns(3,5)P2)."〔译：磷酸肌醇磷酸酶，特异性水解 PtdIns(3,4,5)P3、PtdIns(4,5)P2 与 PtdIns(3,5)P2 的 5 位磷酸——纤毛膜磷脂信号正常功能。〕；【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】纤毛膜肌醇磷脂 5-磷酸酶，调控纤毛磷脂信号与逆向运输（PMID 27927754、26490104）【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.1-2）：“Molar tooth sign (MTS). MRI findings comprise the following: … Hypoplasia of the vermis (the midline portion of the cerebellum)”〔译：磨牙征（MTS）。MRI 表现包括以下各项：……小脑蚓部（小脑中线部分）发育不良。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（补证 PMID 42750441：“KCNA1 encodes the α-subunit of the voltage-gated potassium channel KV1.1.”）〔译：KCNA1 编码电压门控钾通道 KV1.1 的 α 亚基。〕
evidence_path_h: path·PC_loss（PMID 42290287（EA1/EA2 各 1 例尸检），Results（EA1 病例），全文）："segmental Purkinje cell loss"〔译：节段性浦肯野细胞丢失。〕〔注：原引「more pronounced Purkinje cell degeneration」为变性措辞不达 PC_loss 直述门槛，已按外部核验意见换 Results 的 loss 直述句（回放核验待原文全文）；n=1（EA1），EA2 病例不并入计数。〕path·PC_loss（PMID 42290287，摘要）：“Both revealed cerebellar pathology, with EA1 showing more pronounced Purkinje cell degeneration, while EA2 demonstrated previously undescribed p62-positive inclusions.”〔译：两者均显示小脑病理改变：EA1 的浦肯野细胞变性更为显著，而 EA2 可见既往未描述的 p62 阳性包涵体。〕｜尸检例数核对：PMID 42290287 摘要明示 2 名基因确诊尸检患者分别为 EA1（KCNA1 p.Val174Phe）与 EA2（CACNA1A p.Ala253Tyr），本行 EA1 仅 1 例；EA2 的 p62 阳性包涵体不属本行，不得合并计为 2 例 EA1 ‖ path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 36560997，Discussion（转述 Lee 2021 个例），全文）：“Brain MRI showed cerebellar atrophy.”〔译：脑 MRI 显示小脑萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（PMID 19953606，260 例家系筛查＋爪蟾卵母细胞电生理）：“One g.10684G>A (p.Arg420His) mutation caused late-onset ataxia resulting in a nonfunctional channel subunit with dominant-negative properties.”〔译：g.10684G>A（p.Arg420His）突变导致迟发型共济失调，其通道亚基无功能并具显性负效应。〕；另 PMID 23912307（同一等位基因的家系表型研究）：“The p.Arg420His allelic form of spinocerebellar ataxia type 13 has been reported in a large Filipino kindred…”〔译：SCA13 的 p.Arg420His 等位基因型已在一个大型菲律宾家系中报道。〕注：本行为成人起病 R420H 型，证据已改取 R420H 专属文献；原引 PMID 40128944（R423H 婴幼儿型）属等位基因错配，已移除。
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 23912307；PMC3824261 Results，全文）：“MR scans of the brain in four test subjects revealed isolated cerebellar atrophy”〔译：4 名受试者的脑部 MR 扫描显示孤立性小脑萎缩。〕

disease_name_h: SCA13 (R423H 婴儿起病型, 伴智力障碍)
evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（UniProt Q14003，Function）："Voltage-gated potassium channel that plays an important role in the rapid repolarization of fast-firing brain neurons."〔译：电压门控钾通道，参与快速放电神经元的快速复极化——野生型 Kv3.3 正常功能。〕；突变功能实验另记：mech·channel_synapse（PMID 28467418，摘要）："Mechanistically, genetic studies in Drosophila, along with cellular and biophysical studies in mammalian systems, demonstrate the dominant negative effect exerted by the mutant on the wild-type (WT) protein, which explains dominant inheritance."〔译：机制上，果蝇遗传学研究与哺乳系统的细胞及生物物理学研究共同证明该突变体对野生型（WT）蛋白具有显性负效应，这解释了其显性遗传方式。〕；同摘要另一结果句："Furthermore, human KCNC3R423H expression in mammalian cells results in altered glycosylation and aberrant retention of the channel in anterograde and/or endosomal vesicles. Confirmation of the absence of plasma membrane targeting was based on the loss of current conductance in cells expressing the mutant channel."〔译：此外，人 KCNC3R423H 在哺乳细胞中的表达导致糖基化异常及通道在顺行转运和/或内体囊泡中的异常滞留；确认质膜靶向缺失的依据是表达突变通道的细胞丧失电流电导。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_hypoplasia（PMID 28467418；pone.0173565.pdf p.1）：“We detail the clinical phenotype of four SCA13 kindreds that confirm causation of the KCNC3R423H allele. The heralding features demonstrate congenital onset with non-progressive, neurodevelopmental cerebellar hypoplasia and lifetime improvement in motor and cognitive function that implicate compensatory neural mechanisms.”〔译：本文详述 4 个 SCA13 家系的临床表型，确认 KCNC3 R423H 等位的致病性；其首发特征为先天起病、非进展性的神经发育性小脑发育不良，运动与认知功能终生改善，提示存在代偿性神经机制。〕〔注：原 PDF 中 "developmental" 一词曾断为 "deve lopmental"，引用时已修复。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（UniProt Q9UK17，Function）："Pore-forming (alpha) subunit of voltage-gated A-type potassium channels that mediates transmembrane potassium transport in excitable membranes, in brain and heart."〔译：电压门控 A 型钾通道的成孔（α）亚基，介导可兴奋膜（脑与心脏）的跨膜钾转运——KCND3 即 Kv4.3。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 42712185，摘要）：“Clinically, the twins exhibited severe intellectual disability, developmental delay, and cerebellar atrophy with pontine flattening, without epilepsy.”〔译：临床上，这对双胞胎表现为严重智力障碍、发育迟缓，以及伴脑桥变平的小脑萎缩，无癫痫。〕path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 35949253，Palombo 2022 Neurol Genet，意大利独立家系 V374A KCND3 第二例，全文）：“He had marked cerebellar atrophy at brain MRI, more evident at vermis ( Figure, A–C ).”〔译：该患者脑 MRI 显示明显小脑萎缩，以蚓部为著。〕；图注：“(A–C) Brain MRI shows severe cerebellar atrophy more evident at vermis.”〔译：脑 MRI 示重度小脑萎缩，以蚓部为著。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（补证 PMID 41148001：“KIAA0586, which encodes the centrosomal protein TALPID3, essential for ciliogenesis and Hedgehog signaling.”）〔译：KIAA0586 编码中心体蛋白 TALPID3，是纤毛发生与 Hedgehog 信号所必需。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 26096313（KIAA0586/JBTS23 确诊系列，9 名双等位患者/366 个 JS 家系），Results）："All individuals have the Molar Tooth Sign (MTS) on brain MRI and additional brain anomalies include brainstem heterotopia in two individuals (UW174-3 and UW177-3), dysplasia of the cerebellar hemispheres in one individual and a thick and dysplastic corpus callosum in a fourth individual (Figure 2)."〔译：所有受累者脑 MRI 均有磨牙征，另见脑干异位（2 例）、小脑半球发育不良（1 例）与胼胝体增厚发育不良（1 例）。〕〔注：原 9 月龄男婴单例（PMID 41020477）降为补充；【罕少病例外】撤销——2015 年即有 9 个确诊家系，非罕少病。〕〔句经 PMC 全文逐字核验。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cytoskeleton_transport_glia（UniProt O43896，Function）："Motor required for the retrograde transport of Golgi vesicles to the endoplasmic reticulum. Has a microtubule plus end-directed motility."〔译：驱动高尔基囊泡逆向转运至内质网的马达蛋白，具微管正端定向运动性——KIF1C 正常轴突运输功能。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（s10048-025-00844-5.pdf p.1；本地 s10048-025-00844-5.pdf）：“suggesting regionally restricted, but bilaterally symmetric, hypomyelination of the cerebral white matter”〔译：提示大脑白质存在区域局限但双侧对称的低髓鞘化。〕 ；path·corticospinal_tract（PMID 40794111；d060.pdf p.1，Fig. 1 图注）：“(c) T2-weighted images highlight involvement of superior cerebellar peduncles and their decussation (arrowhead), corticospinal tracts at cerebral peduncles (star), and posterior internal capsules (cross).”〔译：T2 加权像见小脑上脚及其交叉、大脑脚皮质脊髓束与后部内囊受累。〕〔模态：MRI；物种：人；n=1〕；path·white_matter【2025 两姐妹 Teaching NeuroImage，全文核对】（PMID 40773693（Saletti 2025 Neurology 105:e214000），Results，全文）：“Brain MRI revealed bilateral white matter T2-FLAIR hyperintensities, with T1 isointensity in cortico spinal tracts, cerebellar peduncles, and periventricular regions (Figure).”〔译：脑 MRI 示双侧白质 T2-FLAIR 高信号，T1 等信号见于皮质脊髓束、小脑脚与脑室周区域——呈低髓鞘化白质脑病模式。〕〔注：两姐妹（19/12 岁，巴基斯坦近亲家系），双等位 KIF1C c.298G>A p.Gly100Arg（ACMG Class 4）；white_matter 与 corticospinal_tract 的 A 级由此强化。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·other（膜金属内肽酶 neprilysin）（补证 PMID 41526199）：“Neprilysin (NEP) is a major enzyme that degrades amyloid β-peptide (Aβ) in the brain.”〔译：脑啡肽酶（neprilysin，由 MME 编码的膜金属内肽酶）是脑内降解 β-淀粉样肽的主要酶；另可降解多种血管活性肽。〕; mech=mito_metabolic（PMID 27583304，正文）：“a zinc-dependent metalloprotease that cleaves peptides”译：一种能够切割肽类底物的锌依赖性金属蛋白酶。
evidence_path_h: path·peripheral_nerve（PMID 42132968｜s12311-026-02023-0.pdf p.1）：“Ages of onset ranged from the fifth to seventh decade, and neurophysiological studies in the original kindred consistently showed length-dependent axonal neuropathy”〔译：起病年龄为第五至第七个十年，且原家系的神经生理学研究一致显示长度依赖性轴索性神经病。〕path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 27583304，Depondt 2016 Neurol Genet，比利时 SCA43 家系，全文）：“Brain MRI showed moderate cerebellar vermis atrophy ( figure 2 ).”〔译：先证者（III-4）脑 MRI 显示中度小脑蚓部萎缩。〕；图 2 图注：“Sagittal T2-weighted MRI image from individual III-4 showing moderate atrophy of the cerebellar vermis.”〔译：个体 III-4 的矢状位 T2 加权 MRI 示小脑蚓部中度萎缩。〕；“Two participants had an MRI showing cerebellar vermis atrophy.”〔译：另有 2 名参与者的 MRI 显示小脑蚓部萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·dna_repair（PMID 38888340，摘要）：“The MRE11/RAD50/NBS1 (MRN) complex plays critical roles in cellular responses to DNA double-strand breaks.”〔译：MRE11/RAD50/NBS1（MRN）复合体在细胞对 DNA 双链断裂的应答中起关键作用。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 38380400（ATLD1 八例沙特家系电生理系列），摘要/Results，全文）：“All investigated patients had cerebellar atrophy on brain MRI (5/5).”〔译：所有受检患者脑 MRI 均见小脑萎缩（5/5）。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（UniProt O00567，Function）："Involved in the early to middle stages of 60S ribosomal subunit biogenesis. Required for the biogenesis of box C/D snoRNAs such U3, U8 and U14 snoRNAs."〔译：参与 60S 核糖体亚基成熟早中期，为 box C/D snoRNA（U3/U8/U14）生物发生所必需——NOP56 的 snoRNP/rRNA 加工正常功能。〕；mech·proteostasis_RNA（PMID 36741964；PMC9892063 NOP56 and RNA processing，全文）：“The donor provided upstream of snoRD86 is spliced to form mRNA encoding NOP56, and the donor provided downstream of snoRD86 is spliced to form the substrate mRNA of the NMD pathway, which is mediated by SMG6 to generate snoRD86-cSPA, which is a lncRNA.”〔译：snoRD86 上游的供体位点剪接形成编码 NOP56 的 mRNA，其下游供体位点剪接则形成 NMD 通路的底物 mRNA，该通路经 SMG6 介导生成 snoRD86-cSPA，后者为一种长链非编码 RNA。〕
evidence_path_h: path·PC_loss（PMID 22744658，摘要）：“The neuropathologic study revealed significant cerebellar Purkinje cell degeneration with obvious loss of lower motor neurons.”〔译：神经病理研究显示显著的小脑浦肯野细胞变性，并见下运动神经元明显丢失。〕 ；path·olivopontocerebellar（补证 GeneReviews（PMID 25101480，SCA36 条目）：“Brain MRI shows atrophy of the cerebellar vermis in initial stages, later evolving to a pattern of olivopontocerebellar atrophy.”〔译：早期 MRI 显示小脑蚓部萎缩，后期演变为橄榄脑桥小脑萎缩模式。〕）｜补充独立人脑尸检：PMID 25476002（Obayashi 2015）结论 “Neuropathology in a presymptomatic case disclosed that Purkinje cells and hypoglossal neurons are affected”〔译：1 例临床前期携带者的神经病理见浦肯野细胞与舌下神经核神经元受累〕；与 PMID 22744658（2012，18 例中 1 例有症状患者的尸检）合计至少 2 名独立个体 → PC_loss=A 保留。；path·PC_loss【2015 尸检直述句（症状前个体，全文核对）】（PMID 25476002（Obayashi 2015 JNNP，SCA36 法/德/日多队列），Neuropathological findings 节，全文）：“The neuropathological examination of patient AAD508#7 revealed diffuse cortical cerebellar atrophy.”及：“Histology demonstrated a mild Purkinje cell loss with Bergmann’s gliosis (ﬁgure 3A, black arrow)”〔译：患者 AAD508#7（83 岁死亡的症状前携带者）的神经病理检查示弥漫性小脑皮质萎缩；组织学示轻度浦肯野细胞丢失伴 Bergmann 胶质增生（图 3A）。〕〔注：该直述句系 GPT 第七批指定的定位目标，现已逐字断言；但为症状前单例尸检（n=1），PC_loss 等级口径见 P。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 NPHP1—JBTS4）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】属已确立的 Joubert/纤毛病致病基因；本表未检索到该基因特异的直接功能实验，由基因到纤毛表型的中介环节尚未完全阐明，不以综合征共性冒充本基因的独立机制证明。【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕；基因特异功能（UniProt O15259，Function）："May play a role in the regulation of intraflagellar transport (IFT) during cilia assembly."〔译：可能在纤毛组装过程中参与调节鞭毛内运输（IFT）。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.1-2）：“Molar tooth sign (MTS). MRI findings comprise the following: … Hypoplasia of the vermis (the midline portion of the cerebellum)”〔译：磨牙征（MTS）。MRI 表现包括以下各项：……小脑蚓部（小脑中线部分）发育不良。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 OFD1—JBTS10）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】属已确立的 Joubert/纤毛病致病基因；本表未检索到该基因特异的直接功能实验，由基因到纤毛表型的中介环节尚未完全阐明，不以综合征共性冒充本基因的独立机制证明。【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕；基因特异功能（UniProt O75665，Function）："Component of the centrioles controlling mother and daughter centrioles length."〔译：中心粒组分，控制母、子中心粒长度。〕；同条目另述："Involved in the biogenesis of the cilium, a centriole-associated function."〔译：参与纤毛的生物发生，这是一项中心粒相关功能。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics—Brain Anomalies」，GeneReviews Joubert Syndrome and Related Disorders，PMID 20301500）：“Hypoplasia of the vermis (the midline portion of the cerebellum)”〔译：小脑蚓部（小脑中线部分）发育不良。〕（磨牙征 MRI 表现列表项）；另（同章 Genetic Counseling—Prenatal Testing and Preimplantation Genetic Testing）：“When detection of cerebellar vermis hypoplasia by routine prenatal ultrasound examination raises the possibility of JS, fetal MRI may detect the typical molar tooth sign (MTS); however, the sensitivity and specificity of this prenatal finding remain unknown [Doherty et al 2005, Quarello et al 2014, Bachmann-Gagescu et al 2020, Yen 2024].”〔译：当常规产前超声检出小脑蚓部发育不良提示 JS 可能时，胎儿 MRI 可检出具特征性磨牙征（MTS）；但该产前征象的敏感度与特异度仍未知。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cytoskeleton_transport_glia（PMID 42031848；PMC13109364 Introduction，全文）：“The oligophrenin-1 (OPHN1) gene is located on the human X chromosome and encodes a Rho GAP protein containing Bin/Amphiphysin/Rvs (BAR) and Pleckstrin Homology (PH) domains that bind to actin or phospholipids, respectively”〔译：少突胶质细胞脑蛋白 1（OPHN1）基因位于人类 X 染色体，编码含 Bin/Amphiphysin/Rvs（BAR）与普列克底物同源（PH）结构域的 Rho GAP 蛋白，二者分别结合肌动蛋白与磷脂。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_hypoplasia（PMID 41736477；PMC13167628 4.2.6 OPHN1，全文）：“This syndrome is characterized by moderately to severely impaired intellectual development, cerebellar hypoplasia, seizures, and dysmorphic facial features.”〔译：该综合征以中度至重度智力发育受损、小脑发育不良、癫痫发作及面容异常为特征。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·other（PMID 21035104，摘要）：“PDYN is the precursor protein for the opioid neuropeptides, α-neoendorphin, and dynorphins A and B (Dyn A and B).”〔译：PDYN 是阿片类神经肽 α-新内啡肽以及强啡肽 A、B 的前体蛋白。〕；mech=channel_synapse（PMID 27260403，摘要）：“loss of opioid-mediated neuroprotection and NMDA-mediated excitotoxicity”。译：研究提出，阿片受体介导的神经保护作用降低与NMDA介导的兴奋性毒性共同参与SCA23发病。

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（II 型跨膜糖蛋白，溶酶体 5′-3′ 核酸外切酶）（补证 PMID 41780338）：“PLD3, a type-II transmembrane glycoprotein enriched in late endosomes and lysosomes, governs nucleic-acid turnover, immune signalling and intracellular homeostasis…”〔译：PLD3 为富集于晚期内体与溶酶体的 II 型跨膜糖蛋白，主管核酸周转、免疫信号与胞内稳态；其 5′-3′ 核酸外切酶活性即由此而来。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 42703731，Abstract）：“Phosphomannomutase 2 congenital disorder of glycosylation (PMM2-CDG) is a rare, autosomal recessive disease caused by PMM2 deficiency, which impairs conversion of mannose-6-phosphate into mannose-1-phosphate (M1P) and disrupts N-linked glycosylation.”〔译：PMM2-CDG 由 PMM2 缺陷引起，后者使 6-磷酸甘露糖不能转化为 1-磷酸甘露糖（M1P），并破坏 N-连接糖基化。〕〔机制层级：酶缺陷→底物转化障碍→糖基化异常；直接支撑 mito_metabolic 分箱〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 37955240（PMM2 分子确诊临床队列 n=51），Results，摘要）："Progressive cerebellar atrophy is the characteristic neuroimaging finding."〔译：进行性小脑萎缩是 PMM2-CDG 的特征性神经影像发现。〕〔注：原 unknown=Q 系漏检——NBK1110（PMM2-CDG GeneReviews）明确记载婴儿期小脑发育不良、随后进行性萎缩；本句经 PubMed 摘要逐字核验。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt Q10713，Function）："Substrate recognition and binding subunit of the essential mitochondrial processing protease (MPP), which cleaves the mitochondrial sequence off newly imported precursors proteins."〔译：线粒体加工肽酶（MPP）的底物识别与结合亚基——MPP 切除新输入线粒体前体蛋白的线粒体靶向序列。PMPCA 正常功能。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 38235041（PMPCA 相关脑病，新变异与表型扩展）：“Cerebellar atrophy and striatum changes were found in severe cases.”）〔译：重症病例可见小脑萎缩与纹状体改变。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·dna_repair（UniProt Q96T60，Function）："Plays a key role in the repair of DNA damage, functioning as part of both the non-homologous end-joining (NHEJ) and base excision repair (BER) pathways. Through its two catalytic activities, PNK ensures that DNA termini are compatible with extension and ligation."〔译：在 DNA 损伤修复中起关键作用——同时参与 NHEJ 与 BER 通路；经其两个催化活性（激酶/磷酸酶）使 DNA 末端可被延伸与连接。PNKP 正常功能。〕〔注：原引 PMID 32504494 句仅述「突变致神经疾病谱」且中文译含增译，已更换。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 25728773；PMC4375449 Results，全文）：“In all 11 individuals, brain MRIs revealed cerebellar atrophy.”〔译：全部 11 例个体的脑 MRI 均显示小脑萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt Q8IY17，Function）："Phospholipase B that deacylates intracellular phosphatidylcholine (PtdCho), generating glycerophosphocholine (GroPtdCho). evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 42147656；PMC13175278 Imaging，全文）：“Brain MRI demonstrated cerebellar atrophy characterized by prominence of cerebellar folia, widening of cerebellar sulci, and enlargement of the fourth ventricle.”〔译：脑 MRI 显示小脑萎缩，表现为小脑叶片突出、小脑沟加宽及第四脑室扩大。〕path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 37070034 / PMC10105095，Mahajan 2023 Mov Disord Clin Pract，Boucher-Neuhäuser 双胞胎 2 例，全文）：“Brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) in both patients revealed severe cerebellar atrophy (Fig. 2 ).”〔译：两名患者的脑 MRI 均显示重度小脑萎缩。〕

disease_name_h: POLG-ANS（POLG 相关共济失调-神经病谱）
evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 42238689，摘要）：“POLG-related disorders are a group of mitochondrial diseases caused by variants in the POLG gene, which is essential for mitochondrial DNA replication and repair.”〔译：POLG 相关疾病是一组线粒体病，由 POLG 基因变异引起；该基因对线粒体 DNA 复制与修复至关重要。〕
evidence_path_h: path·peripheral_nerve（补证 PMID 42699627（POLG 谱系病例，三次系列肌电图）：“Three serial electroneuromyographic studies demonstrated stable chronic axonal polyneuropathy with complete bilateral absence of sural, fibular, and plantar sensory potentials, and active distal denervation.”〔译：三次系列肌电图显示稳定的慢性轴索性多发性神经病，双侧腓肠、腓总与足底感觉电位完全消失，并见活动性远端失神经。〕；另 PMID 42903362：“Mutations in the mitochondrial DNA polymerase gamma (POLG) gene cause a broad spectrum of neurodegenerative disorders, including the ataxia-neuropathy spectrum (ANS).”〔译：POLG 突变引起包括共济失调-神经病谱系（ANS）在内的一系列神经退行性疾病。〕） ；path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 41245005（POLG 相关小脑共济失调 scoping review，N=184），摘要/Results，全文）："A slowly progressive cerebellar ataxia in combination with sensory neuropathy, progressive external ophthalmoplegia, epilepsy, myoclonus, and characteristic imaging findings"〔译：缓慢进展的小脑共济失调，伴感觉性神经病、进行性眼外肌麻痹、癫痫、肌阵挛及特征性影像表现。〕；同文 Results/Tables 结果句："Brain MRI commonly exhibited different degrees of vermis or cerebellar hemisphere atrophy (58 patients, 31.5%), which in most cases was mild to moderate."〔译：脑 MRI 常见不同程度蚓部或小脑半球萎缩（58 例，31.5%），多数为轻中度。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（补证 PMID 15543146，Sellick et al. 2004 Nat Genet，摘要）：“…the clinical phenotype of the affected individuals implicated the protein as a key regulator of cerebellar neurogenesis. The essential role of PTF1A in normal cerebellar development was confirmed by detailed neuropathological analysis of Ptf1a(-/-) mice.”〔译：患者临床表型提示该蛋白是小脑神经发生的关键调控因子；Ptf1a 敲除小鼠的神经病理分析证实 PTF1A 在小脑发育中的必需作用。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_agenesis（补证 PMID 15543146，Sellick et al. 2004 Nat Genet，摘要）：“…permanent neonatal diabetes mellitus associated with pancreatic and cerebellar agenesis in a genome-wide linkage search of a consanguineous Pakistani family.”；“Positional cloning identified the mutations 705insG and C886T in the gene PTF1A … as disease-causing sequence changes.”〔译：一个近亲婚配家系中，永久性新生儿糖尿病伴胰腺与小脑发育不全；定位克隆发现 PTF1A 的 705insG 与 C886T 为致病改变。〕

disease_name_h: 无脑回伴小脑发育不良 (LCH)
evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（UniProt P78509，Function）："Extracellular matrix serine protease secreted by pioneer neurons that plays a role in layering of neurons in the cerebral cortex and cerebellum by coordinating cell positioning during neurodevelopment. Regulates microtubule function in neurons and neuronal migration. Binding to the extracellular domains of lipoprotein receptors VLDLR and LRP8/APOER2 induces tyrosine phosphorylation of DAB1 and modulation of TAU phosphorylation."〔译：由先锋神经元分泌的细胞外基质丝氨酸蛋白酶，通过在神经发育过程中协调细胞定位，参与大脑皮质与小脑神经元的分层；调节神经元微管功能与神经元迁移；与脂蛋白受体 VLDLR 及 LRP8/APOER2 胞外域结合可诱导 DAB1 酪氨酸磷酸化并调节 TAU 磷酸化。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_hypoplasia（PMID 35769015（Di Donato 等，双等位 RELN 7 例），Results – Brain imaging—biallelic，全文）：“Brain MRI in six children and head CT scan in one boy demonstrated the same pattern of malformations described in previous reports including anterior predominant LIS with severe pachygyria over the frontal and anterior temporal regions that transitioned to mild pachygyria posterior to the sylvian fissure”〔译：6 例患儿脑 MRI 与 1 例男童头颅 CT 显示与既往报道一致的畸形模式，包括额叶为主的无脑回伴额部及前颢重度巨脑回，向后于外侧裂后方过渡为轻度巨脑回。〕；另（同文/同章）：“In four children, the pons was small making the ventral brainstem appear flat and the cerebellum was very small with an afoliar surface”〔译：4 例患儿脑桥小，致腹侧脑干外观平坦，小脑极小、表面呈无叶状。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·dna_repair（UniProt P35251，Function）："Subunit of the replication factor C (RFC) complex which acts during elongation of primed DNA templates by DNA polymerases delta and epsilon, and is necessary for ATP-dependent loading of proliferating cell nuclear antigen (PCNA) onto primed DNA (PubMed:9488738). This subunit binds to the primer-template junction."〔译：复制因子 C（RFC）复合体亚基，在 DNA 聚合酶 δ 与 ε 延伸引物模板时起作用，是 ATP 依赖性将增殖细胞核抗原（PCNA）装载到引物 DNA 上的必要条件；本亚基结合引物-模板连接处。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕｜病因机制未定：CANVAS 由 RFC1 内含子双等位 AAGGG 重复扩增引起，重复扩增如何导致神经变性仍有争议（功能缺失、RNA/蛋白毒性等均有假说）；K=dna_repair 仅表示 RFC1 正常蛋白参与 DNA 复制/修复，不可推导为「CANVAS 是已证明的 DNA 修复缺陷病」
evidence_path_h: path·PC_loss（PMID 42871735；PMC13659898 Introduction，全文）：“CANVAS is characterized by combined degeneration of cerebellar Purkinje cells, dorsal root ganglion sensory neurons, and vestibular ganglia”〔译：CANVAS 的特征是小脑浦肯野细胞、背根神经节感觉神经元及前庭神经节的联合变性。〕 ；path·DRG_sensory（与 PC_loss 共用同一病理陈述，原引仅为病例摘要首句、未陈述神经节病理）：PDF 人工核对（PMID 42871735）“CANVAS is characterized by combined degeneration of cerebellar Purkinje cells, dorsal root ganglion sensory neurons, and vestibular ganglia”〔译：CANVAS 的特征是小脑浦肯野细胞、背根神经节感觉神经元与前庭神经节的联合变性。〕；2022 年 RFC1-related disease 专题综述（PMC9425222）总结至少 5 例基因确诊人脑组织样本，重复支持｜补充多尸检依据：2022 年 RFC1-related disease 专题综述（PMC9425222）总结至少 5 例基因确诊人脑组织样本的小脑蚓部浦肯野细胞与背根/前庭神经节神经元丢失；本行 PC_loss=A 与 DRG_sensory=A 不依赖 PMID 42871735 的单病例

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（PMID 42110226；PMC13153464 Results，全文）：“The RBR domain classifies RNF216 as a specialized subset of E3 ubiquitin ligases due to its mechanism that utilizes both RING domains to coordinate protein ubiquitination.”〔译：RBR 结构域使 RNF216 归为 E3 泛素连接酶中的一个特殊亚类，其机制为利用两个 RING 结构域协同完成蛋白泛素化。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 RPGRIP1L—JBTS7）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】属已确立的 Joubert/纤毛病致病基因；本表未检索到该基因特异的直接功能实验，由基因到纤毛表型的中介环节尚未完全阐明，不以综合征共性冒充本基因的独立机制证明。【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕；基因特异功能（UniProt Q68CZ1，Function）："Involved in regulation of proteasomal activity at the primary cilium probably implicating association with PSDM2 (By similarity)."〔译：参与初级纤毛处蛋白酶体活性的调控，可能通过与 PSDM2 的关联实现。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.1）：“Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation recognizable on axial brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as the "molar tooth sign" (MTS).”〔译：Joubert 综合征（JS）除极少数例外，是一种常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，其定义性特征为轴位脑 MRI 上可识别的特征性小脑与脑干畸形，即「磨牙征」（MTS）。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 TCTN2—JBTS24）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】属已确立的 Joubert/纤毛病致病基因；本表未检索到该基因特异的直接功能实验，由基因到纤毛表型的中介环节尚未完全阐明，不以综合征共性冒充本基因的独立机制证明。【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕；基因特异功能（UniProt Q96GX1，Function）："Component of the tectonic-like complex, a complex localized at the transition zone of primary cilia and acting as a barrier that prevents diffusion of transmembrane proteins between the cilia and plasma membranes. Required for hedgehog signaling transduction (By similarity)."〔译：纤毛过渡区类 tectonic 复合体组分，该复合体在初级纤毛过渡区起屏障作用，阻止跨膜蛋白在纤毛膜与质膜间扩散；为 hedgehog 信号转导所必需。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.1）：“Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation recognizable on axial brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) as the "molar tooth sign" (MTS).”〔译：Joubert 综合征（JS）除少数例外为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，其定义性特征是轴位脑 MRI 上可辨认的小脑与脑干畸形，即「磨牙征」（MTS）。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 41538773，摘要）：“Twinkle, encoded by the TWNK gene, is a mitochondrial DNA helicase that unwinds the double helix of DNA during replication, playing a pivotal role in mitochondrial function.”〔译：Twinkle 由 TWNK 基因编码，是线粒体 DNA 解旋酶，复制时解开 DNA 双螺旋，对线粒体功能至关重要。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt Q5JTZ9，Function）："Catalyzes the attachment of alanine to tRNA(Ala) in a two-step reaction: alanine is first activated by ATP to form Ala-AMP and then transferred to the acceptor end of tRNA(Ala)."〔译：催化丙氨酸与 tRNA(Ala) 的两步连接反应——先由 ATP 活化丙氨酸生成 Ala-AMP，再转移到 tRNA(Ala) 接受端。AARS2 为线粒体丙氨酰-tRNA 合成酶，正常功能明确（非 unknown）。〕〔注：原「仅肿瘤论文提及功能所以撤空」的撤回论据删除；accession 经 gene name 验证为 AARS2（Q5JTZ9）。〕

evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（证据更换，原引仅为论文标题、未陈述白质病变）：PMID 42798143（X-ALD PET 影像系统综述，PRISMA）“X-linked adrenoleukodystrophy (X-ALD) is a peroxisomal disorder caused by pathogenic variants in ABCD1, resulting in the accumulation of very long-chain fatty acids and risk of progressive neuroinflammatory demyelination in the cerebral form of ALD. evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt Q8N2K0，Function）："Lysophosphatidylserine (LPS) lipase that mediates the hydrolysis of lysophosphatidylserine, a class of signaling lipids that regulates immunological and neurological processes."〔译：溶血磷脂酰丝氨酸（LPS）脂肪酶，介导溶血磷脂酰丝氨酸的水解——后者是调节免疫与神经过程的信号脂质。ABHD12 正常酶学功能明确（脂质水解；按本库宽义代谢分箱，定位非线粒体）。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 40533696（PHARC/ABHD12 汇总）：“The main finding of Brain MRI was cerebellar atrophy, and demyelinating polyneuropathy was the commonest finding in electroneuromyography, both were found in 28.2% of patients.”）〔译：脑 MRI 的主要发现是小脑萎缩，肌电图最常见的发现是脱髓鞘性多发性神经病，两者均见于 28.2% 的患者。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（PMID 42969215，摘要）：“Human enzymes belonging to the group of RNA-acting adenosine deaminases (ADARs) play a role in the innate antiviral immune response, partly by inducing mutations in viral RNA.”〔译：属于作用于 RNA 的腺苷脱氨酶（ADAR）家族的人源酶参与先天抗病毒免疫应答，其作用机制之一是可在病毒 RNA 中引入突变。〕; mech=proteostasis_RNA (PMID 34380029, Abstract): "This process called A-to-I editing masks self-dsRNA from detection by the antiviral dsRNA sensor MDA5."[译：这一被称为 A-to-I 编辑的过程，使自身双链 RNA 避免被抗病毒双链 RNA 感受器 MDA5 识别。]
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 42033272；PMC13395044 Figure 1 legend，全文）：“(B) Axial T2/FLAIR MRI image of Patient 5 with ADAR ‐related AGS at 10 years 3 months (top) showing atrophy and abnormal signal of the putamina and caudate nuclei, scattered subcortical white matter T2 hyperintensities, and mild sulcal enlargement.”〔译：（B）ADAR 相关 AGS 患者 5 于 10 岁 3 月龄的轴位 T2/FLAIR MRI（上图）显示豆状核与尾状核萎缩及信号异常、散在皮质下白质 T2 高信号，以及轻度脑沟增宽。〕path·white_matter（PMID 28561207（ADAR1 队列 46 例/37 家系，Neuropediatrics 2017）；PMC5985975 全文）：“of 46 patients from 37 families with neurological disease due to mutations in ADAR1”〔译：46 例患者（37 个家系）的 ADAR1 神经系统疾病队列。〕；队列级：“A diagnosis of AGS was suggested by characteristic clinical and neuroimaging features including cerebral atrophy, white matter disease, and intracranial calcification.”〔译：AGS 诊断由特征性临床与神经影像所见支持，包括脑萎缩、白质病变与颅内钙化。〕；Figure 1 图注患者级 MRI（AGS810_P1）：“( C ) T2 axial MR at 5 years shows marked cerebral atrophy, white matter high signal, and signal change and shrinkage of the putamen.”〔译：5 岁时轴位 T2 MR 示明显脑萎缩、白质高信号、壳核信号改变与缩小。〕〔模态：MRI；物种：人；队列 n=46（ADAR1），图注 2 例患者级白质 MRI（AGS150、AGS810_P1）〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 ARMC9—JBTS30）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】属已确立的 Joubert/纤毛病致病基因；本表未检索到该基因特异的直接功能实验，由基因到纤毛表型的中介环节尚未完全阐明，不以综合征共性冒充本基因的独立机制证明。【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕；基因特异功能（UniProt Q7Z3E5，Function）："Involved in ciliogenesis (PubMed:32453716). It is required for appropriate acetylation and polyglutamylation of ciliary microtubules, and regulation of cilium length (PubMed:32453716)."〔译：参与纤毛发生；为纤毛微管适当的乙酰化与多谷氨酰化及纤毛长度调控所必需。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.1-2）：“Molar tooth sign (MTS). MRI findings comprise the following: … Hypoplasia of the vermis (the midline portion of the cerebellum)”〔译：磨牙征（MTS）。MRI 表现包括：……小脑蚓部（小脑中线部分）发育不良。〕

[译：在尚无明显神经系统症状的肝型 Wilson 病患者中，也观察到了小脑萎缩。]

evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 40665687；PMC13142883 全文，Genotype-phenotype correlation 节）：“Clinically, P1 presented with MDDG type A (muscle-eye-brain disease) characterized by brainstem malformation and cerebellar atrophy”〔译：临床 P1 表现为 MDDG A 型（肌眼脑病），特征为脑干畸形与小脑萎缩。〕；基因型确认（同节）：“Patient 1 (P1) harbored c.1307A > G (p.Y436C) and c.261-2A > G”〔译：患者 1（P1）携带 c.1307A>G（p.Y436C）与 c.261-2A>G——确认该文 P1 为 B3GALNT2 基因型。〕〔模态：MRI/临床；物种：人；n=1（MDDG-A/MEB 型 P1）〕;path=cerebellar_hypoplasia（PMID 23453667，Figure 1A）：“ponto-cerebellar hypoplasia”。译：患者 MRI 显示脑桥小脑发育不良。

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 36136859｜awac344.pdf p.1）：“Evidence of the underlying mitochondrial bioenergetic dysfunction complemented our knowledge that the COX20 protein is a mitochondrially located chaperone that aids the assembly of complex IV of the respiratory chain.”〔译：线粒体生物能量学功能障碍的证据，补充了我们对 COX20 蛋白的认识——它是定位于线粒体的伴侣蛋白，协助呼吸链复合物 IV 的装配。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 36136859｜awac344.pdf p.2）：“Brain MRIs showed marginal cerebral atrophy in five patients and cerebellar atrophy in two patients.”〔译：脑 MRI 显示 5 例轻度大脑萎缩、2 例小脑萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 CPLANE1—JBTS17）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】属已确立的 Joubert/纤毛病致病基因；本表未检索到该基因特异的直接功能实验，由基因到纤毛表型的中介环节尚未完全阐明，不以综合征共性冒充本基因的独立机制证明。【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕；基因特异功能（UniProt Q9H799，Function）："Involved in ciliogenesis (PubMed:25877302, PubMed:35582950)."〔译：参与纤毛发生。〕；同条目另述："Involved in recruitment of peripheral IFT-A proteins to basal bodies (By similarity)."〔译：参与将外周 IFT-A 蛋白招募至基体。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325.pdf p.15）：“When detection of cerebellar vermis hypoplasia by routine prenatal ultrasound examination raises the possibility of JS, fetal MRI may detect the typical molar tooth sign (MTS);”〔译：当常规产前超声检查发现小脑蚓部发育不良、提示 Joubert 综合征可能时，胎儿 MRI 可检出典型的磨牙征（MTS）。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cytoskeleton_transport_glia（UniProt P09603，Function）："Cytokine that plays an essential role in the regulation of survival, proliferation and differentiation of hematopoietic precursor cells, especially mononuclear phagocytes, such as macrophages and monocytes."〔译：细胞因子，在造血前体细胞（尤其巨噬细胞/单核细胞等单核吞噬细胞）的存活、增殖与分化调节中起关键作用——CSF1R 配体激活受体维持小胶质细胞存活/稳态（正常受体功能）。〕；致病后果另记：突变致小胶质细胞功能异常（原 N 句移入本注，属疾病后果，不作 K 正常功能）。
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 41915097，摘要）：“In patients with CSF1R-ALSP, brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) shows early white matter lesions followed by brain atrophy accompanied by progressive cognitive, neuropsychiatric, and motor dysfunction.”〔译：CSF1R-ALSP 患者脑 MRI 显示早期白质病变，随后出现脑萎缩，伴进行性认知、神经精神与运动功能障碍。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（awx273.pdf p.1）：“SPG5 is caused by recessive mutations in the gene CYP7B1 encoding oxysterol-7a-hydroxylase. This enzyme is involved in the degradation of cholesterol into primary bile acids. CYP7B1 deficiency has been shown to lead to accumulation of neurotoxic oxysterols.”〔译：SPG5 由 CYP7B1 基因隐性突变引起，该基因编码氧固醇-7α-羟化酶；此酶参与胆固醇降解为初级胆汁酸；CYP7B1 缺陷已被证实导致神经毒性氧固醇蓄积。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（补证 PMID 19187859｜Biancheri 2009 摘要：“two patients who harbored three mutations … in SPG5/CYP7B1 and white matter involvement evidenced at brain MRI”〔译：2 例携带 SPG5/CYP7B1 三个突变的患者，脑 MRI 见白质受累。〕；原引 Brain 2019 只述皮质脊髓束变性、无白质描述，故本条依据该文所引 Biancheri 2009（Neuromuscul Disord），属原始直接证据（PMID 19187859 摘要，2 名 CYP7B1 患者 MRI 白质受累，n=2））

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 42568094，摘要）：“Aspartyl-tRNA synthetase 2 (DARS2), the mitochondrial enzyme responsible for aminoacylation of aspartyl-tRNA, is traditionally known for its effect on protein synthesis.”〔译：DARS2 是线粒体酶，负责天冬氨酰-tRNA 的氨酰化，传统上以其对蛋白质合成的作用为人所知。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 41633674，摘要）：“Brain and spinal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) revealed extensive symmetric white matter abnormalities and long-segment spinal cord involvement.”〔译：脑与脊髓 MRI 见广泛对称性白质异常及长节段脊髓受累。〕path·white_matter（GeneReviews NBK43417（LBSL），「MRI Criteria for LBSL」主标准）：“Signal abnormalities (abnormally low signal on T1-weighted images and abnormally high signal on T2-weighted images) in the following: Cerebral white matter, which is either nonhomogeneous and spotty or homogeneous and confluent, with relative sparing of the directly subcortical white matter”〔译：以下部位信号异常（T1 低信号、T2 高信号）：大脑白质——呈不均一斑点状或均一融合性，直接皮质下白质相对保留。〕；脑干受累（主标准）：“Pyramids and/or decussation of the medial lemniscus in the medulla oblongata”〔译：延髓锥体束和/或内侧丘系交叉。〕〔模态：MRI 诊断标准；物种：人；GeneReviews 权威综合征级〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（PMID 42468917；PMC13379286，全文）：“It is caused by autosomal recessive mutations in the EIF2B1 to EIF2B5 genes, which encode the subunits of the eIF2B complex, a key regulator of protein synthesis and the cellular stress response.”〔译：该病由 EIF2B1 至 EIF2B5 基因的常染色体隐性突变引起，这些基因编码 eIF2B 复合物的各亚基，该复合物是蛋白质合成与细胞应激反应的关键调节因子。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 42468917；PMC13379286，全文）：“The MRI scans demonstrate a distinctive pattern: diffuse T2 hyperintensity of the white matter with progressive rarefaction and cystic degeneration, becoming isointense to CSF on all sequences.”〔译：MRI 扫描呈特征性模式：白质弥漫性 T2 高信号，伴进行性稀疏化与囊性变，各序列上最终与脑脊液等信号。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（补证 PMID 42860075：“SPG46 is a rare autosomal recessive form of hereditary spastic paraplegia (HSP) caused by biallelic pathogenic variants in GBA2, encoding the non-lysosomal glucosylceramidase.”）〔译：GBA2 编码非溶酶体葡糖神经酰胺酶。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 42487556，摘要）：“Cerebellar atrophy was observed in four cases, whereas corpus callosum thinning, cataracts, and hearing impairment were absent.”〔译：4 例可见小脑萎缩，而胼胝体变薄、白内障与听力障碍均缺如。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·other（神经节苷脂诱导分化相关蛋白 2，分子功能未明）（补证 PMID 35158016）：“GDAP2 is a gene highly expressed in the human brain and encodes ganglioside-induced differentiation-associated protein 2 (GDAP2).”〔译：GDAP2 在脑内高表达，编码神经节苷脂诱导分化相关蛋白 2；迄今仅有该命名层面的功能注释，具体通路归属未明。〕
evidence_path_h: path·PC_loss【罕少病例外】（PMID 30084953；PMC7534050，全文）：“there was a cerebello-olivar atrophy with a severe and diffuse loss of Purkinje cells, with an increase of the Bergmann cells and also of the glial cells present in the molecular layer”〔译：可见小脑-橄榄萎缩，浦肯野细胞严重且弥漫性丢失，Bergmann 细胞及分子层内胶质细胞增多。〕 ；path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 30084953；PMC7534050，全文）：“An MRI brain scan revealed mild cerebellar atrophy.”〔译：一次脑 MRI 扫描显示轻度小脑萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cytoskeleton_transport_glia（UniProt P14136，Function）："GFAP, a class-III intermediate filament, is a cell-specific marker that, during the development of the central nervous system, distinguishes astrocytes from other glial cells."〔译：GFAP 为 III 类中间丝，是星形胶质细胞的特异性标志——正常星形胶质细胞中间丝/细胞骨架功能。〕；疾病背景（原引 PMID 42603858）：AxD 由 GFAP 基因变异引起——变异句不作 K 正常功能。
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（Bookshelf_NBK1172「Diagnosis—Suggestive Findings—Brain MRI Findings」，GeneReviews Alexander Disease，PMID 20301351）：“Frontally predominant white matter T2-weighted hyperintensity, basal ganglia involvement, and a periventricular rim are present in most individuals.”〔译：多数患者表现为额叶为主的白质 T2 高信号、基底节受累及室周缘。〕；另（同文/同章）：“Based on a multi-institutional retrospective survey of MRI studies of 217 individuals with leukoencephalopathy [van der Knaap et al 2001], it has been suggested that the presence of four of the five following criteria establishes an MRI-based diagnosis of Alexander disease, which can lead to targeted genetic testing:”〔译：基于对 217 例白质脑病 MRI 的多机构回顾调查[van der Knaap et al 2001]，提出以下 5 项标准中满足 4 项即可建立亚历山大病的 MRI 诊断并指导靶向基因检测：〕

disease_name_h: 进行性肌阵挛癫痫-共济失调
evidence_mech_h: mech·cytoskeleton_transport_glia（UniProt O95249，Function）："Involved in transport from the ER to the Golgi apparatus as well as in intra-Golgi transport. It belongs to a super-family of proteins called t-SNAREs (soluble NSF attachment protein receptor)."〔译：参与内质网→高尔基体转运及高尔基体内转运，属 t-SNARE 蛋白超家族——GOSR2 正常囊泡运输功能（SNARE 介导膜融合）。〕；致病后果另记：突变使 SNARE 复合物部分功能缺失（原 N 句移入本注，属疾病后果）。
evidence_path_h: path·peripheral_nerve（PMID 41261947；PMC12631098，全文）：“nerve conduction studies (NCS) revealed signs of sensory neuronopathy and anterior horn cell involvement”〔译：神经传导检查（NCS）显示感觉神经元病与前角细胞受累的征象。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（UniProt P28799，Function）："Secreted protein that acts as a key regulator of lysosomal function and as a growth factor involved in inflammation, wound healing and cell proliferation. Regulates protein trafficking to lysosomes."〔译：分泌蛋白，为溶酶体功能的关键调节因子，并作为生长因子参与炎症、创伤愈合与增殖；调控向溶酶体的蛋白转运——GRN/颗粒蛋白前体正常功能（溶酶体蛋白稳态 → proteostasis_RNA 分箱）。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 39394881（CLN11 队列扩展研究，9 个无关拉美家系各 1 例），Results，全文逐字回放（ScienceDirect 开放获取 CC-BY））：“Nine CLN11 patients from unrelated families were evaluated.”〔译：评估了来自 9 个无关家系的 9 名 CLN11 患者。〕；MRI 结果句（同文 Results）：“All patients had cerebellar atrophy on brain magnetic resonance imaging (Figure 3).”〔译：所有患者脑 MRI 均见小脑萎缩（图 3）——9/9 阳性。〕；Figure 3 图注：“Magnetic resonance imaging showing marked cerebellar atrophy with vermian predominance in a patient with CLN11.”〔译：MRI 示一名 CLN11 患者显著小脑萎缩、以蚓部为主。〕〔模态：MRI；物种：人；n=9/9〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 42511849；PMC13411418，全文）：“This enzyme catalyzes the conversion of GM2 into GM3 ganglioside by cleaving the terminal N-acetylgalactosamine (GalNAc) residue from GM2, thereby facilitating the stepwise degradation of complex glycosphingolipids within neuronal tissue”〔译：该酶通过切除 GM2 末端的 N-乙酰半乳糖胺（GalNAc）残基，催化 GM2 转化为 GM3 神经节苷脂，从而促进神经组织内复杂糖鞘脂的逐步降解。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（Bookshelf_NBK1218.pdf p.7）：“Cerebellar atrophy is evident even early in the disease, at times out of proportion to the extent of cerebellar deficits, and is almost universal in LOTS.”〔译：小脑萎缩在疾病早期即可见，有时与小脑功能障碍的程度不成比例，在晚发型 Tay-Sachs（LOTS）中几乎普遍存在。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（补证 PMID 41795546：“Tay-Sachs and Sandhoff diseases, are sphingolipidoses caused by rare genetic mutations in the HEXA and HEXB genes, that encode the alpha and beta subunits of lysosomal hexosaminidase, respectively.”）〔译：HEXB 编码溶酶体 β-氨基己糖苷酶的 β 亚基。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 42547667；PMC13433390，全文）：“cerebellar atrophy with associated enlargement of the 4th ventricle is reported in both LOTS and LOSD”〔译：小脑萎缩伴第四脑室扩大在 LOTS 与 LOSD 中均有报道。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·other（PMID 24686847，摘要）：“We found that heterozygous mutations in the cytosolic double-stranded RNA receptor gene IFIH1 (also called MDA5) cause a spectrum of neuroimmunological features consistently associated with an enhanced interferon state.”〔译：我们发现，胞质双链 RNA 感受器基因 IFIH1（又称 MDA5）的杂合突变导致一系列神经免疫表型，并始终伴随干扰素反应增强。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 26833990（de novo IFIH1 致病变异致 AGS 病例报道），摘要）：“Brain imaging revealed white matter abnormalities and extensive calcifications.”〔译：脑影像显示白质异常与广泛钙化。〕〔模态：脑影像（MRI/CT）；物种：人；n=1（IFIH1 确诊患儿）〕path·white_matter（PMID 40043752，摘要）：“… syndrome (AGS) is a genetically heterogeneous type-I interferonopathy presenting in infancy with intracranial calcifications, white matter lesions, and brain atrophy.”〔译：Aicardi-Goutières 综合征是遗传异质性的 I 型干扰素病，婴儿期起病，表现为颅内钙化、白质病变与脑萎缩。〕｜补充病型特异人源证据：PMID 26833990（IFIH1 新发致病变异致 AGS 的患儿，含临床与病理资料）报告严重钙化性脑病；另有 IFIH1 嵌合变异兄弟的白质 MRI 改变病例。原 O 列的泛 AGS 白质描述仅作综合征共性背景，不作为 IFIH1 特异的患者级发生率依据。

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse（PMID 41724667，摘要）：“KCNJ10 encodes an inwardly rectifying potassium channel Kir4.1, which is essential for preserving potassium ion homeostasis.”〔译：KCNJ10 编码内向整流钾通道 Kir4.1，对维持钾离子稳态至关重要。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 29666984（EAST 综合征/KCNJ10，2 例随访 10 与 19 年）：“The follow-up studies, performed, respectively, after 19 and 10 years, showed mild cerebellar atrophy and slight progression of the brain and spinal cord T2 signal abnormalities…”）〔译：随访 19 年与 10 年后，分别显示轻度小脑萎缩及脑与脊髓 T2 信号异常的轻度进展……〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt Q9H9P8，Function）："Catalyzes the oxidation of L-2-hydroxyglutarate to 2-oxoglutarate in the mitochondrial matrix (PubMed:15548604, PubMed:16005139, PubMed:40870031)."〔译：在线粒体基质中催化 L-2-羟基戊二酸氧化为 2-酮戊二酸（α-酮戊二酸）。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕〔另注：原句混入无关基因 RYR1 内容，已整段替换；任务书所给 Q9H0V1 实为其他条目，L2HGDH 正确 accession 为 Q9H9P8。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 40660807，摘要）：“In addition to the classic cranial MRI findings of subcortical white matter involvement, basal ganglia involvement was detected in 60 % of cases.”〔译：除皮质下白质受累的经典头颅 MRI 表现外，60% 病例还可见基底节受累。〕 ；path·cerebellar_atrophy（10.1515_jpem-2025-0021.pdf p.3）：“Neuroimaging findings indicated periventricular white matter involvement in 20 % (2/10) of cases … and cerebral and cerebellar atrophy in 10 % (1/10) (Figure 1).”〔译：神经影像显示 20%（2/10）病例存在脑室周白质受累……10%（1/10）存在大脑及小脑萎缩（图 1）。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cytoskeleton_transport_glia（核纤层结构蛋白）（PMID 40025114）：“Lamin B1 (LMNB1) is an intermediate filament protein that is an integral component of the nuclear lamina, a structure that is critical for nuclear organization and function.”〔译：核纤层蛋白 B1（LMNB1）是一种中间丝蛋白，是核纤层的固有组分；核纤层对核的组织与功能至关重要。〕按定义表「细胞骨架与运输/胶质」中“细胞骨架”一项归类（核纤层属中间丝骨架系统）。
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（更换证据，原引为论文标题式表述“An early-onset case of…”，无影像或病理所见）：PMID 28769756（中国 ADLD 家系，LMNB1 全基因重复）：“MRI brain scan identified bilateral symmetric white matter (WM) hyper-intensities in periventricular and semi-oval WM, cerebral peduncles and middle cerebellar peduncles.”〔译：脑 MRI 见双侧对称的白质高信号，位于脑室周围与半卵圆中心白质、大脑脚及小脑中脚。〕；另 PMID 30697589（93 例成人起病白质脑病队列）进一步描述 LMNB1 重排患者的临床与 MRI 特征

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt O00754，Function）："Can hydrolyze a variety of glycan substrates containing terminal alpha-mannosidic linkages. Cleaves alpha 1,2-, alpha 1,3-, and alpha 1,6-linked mannose residues on oligosaccharides generated by N-glycoprotein degradation pathways."〔译：水解多种含末端 α-甘露糖苷键的聚糖底物，切割 N-糖蛋白降解产生的寡糖上的 α1,2-/α1,3-/α1,6-连接甘露糖残基——MAN2B1 正常溶酶体 α-甘露糖苷酶催化功能（定位：溶酶体，非线粒体）。〕；诊断学补充（原引，Bookshelf_NBK1396.pdf p.2）：“The diagnosis of alpha-mannosidosis is established in a proband by identification of deficiency of lysosomal enzyme acid alpha-mannosidase (typically 5%-10% of normal activity) in leukocytes or other nucleated cells AND/OR by the identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in MAN2B1 by molecular genetic testing.”〔译：α-甘露糖苷病的诊断依据为：患者白细胞或其他有核细胞中溶酶体酶酸性 α-甘露糖苷酶活性缺乏（通常为正常的 5%–10%），和/或分子遗传学检测发现 MAN2B1 双等位基因致病变异。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（Bookshelf_NBK1396.pdf p.9）：“The most common neuroimaging features, especially in untreated individuals, are white matter abnormalities consistent with dysmyelination and progressive cortical and cerebellar atrophy (especially of the cerebellar vermis)”〔译：最常见的神经影像学特征（尤其在未治疗者中）为符合髓鞘形成不良的白质异常，以及进行性皮层与小脑萎缩（尤以小脑蚓部为著）。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 39995633，摘要）：“The MARS2 gene is responsible for binding methionine to mitochondrial tRNA.”〔译：MARS2 基因负责将甲硫氨酸加载到线粒体 tRNA 上。〕;mech=mito_metabolic (PMID 22448145, Abstract): "Analysis of patient cells revealed decreased levels of MARS2 protein and a reduced rate of mitochondrial protein synthesis." [译：患者细胞中 MARS2 蛋白水平下降，线粒体蛋白合成速率降低，支持线粒体翻译障碍作为直接致病机制。]
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 22448145；PMC3308940 全文）：“ARSAL is found in a large cohort of French-Canadian families and is an autosomal recessive spastic ataxia frequently associated with white matter changes as detected by MRI”〔译：ARSAL 见于一个大型法裔加拿大家系队列，为常染色体隐性痉挛性共济失调，常伴 MRI 可见的白质改变。〕〔模态：MRI；物种：人；n=队列（法裔加拿大 ARSAL 家系）〕path·white_matter（PMID 16672289（Thiffault 2006 Brain，ARSAL 原始映射研究），摘要）：“We identified a group of 23 French-Canadian cases belonging to 17 families affected by an autosomal recessive spastic ataxia associated with frequent white matter changes.”〔译：我们识别出 23 例法裔加拿大患者（17 个家系），患常染色体隐性痉挛性共济失调，常伴白质改变。〕；同摘要：“the presence of white matter changes on MRI in 52.4% of cases”〔译：52.4% 的病例 MRI 见白质改变。〕〔模态：MRI；物种：人；n=23 例/17 家系，MRI 白质阳性 52.4%〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 MKS1—JBTS28）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】过渡区蛋白；MKS1 变异患者成纤维细胞见纤毛及 ARL13B、INPP5E 定位异常（PMID 26490104）【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 33193692（MKS1 复合杂合 JBTS 病例），Figure 1B 图注，全文）："Brain MRI of the proband showing the typical molar tooth sign and cerebellar vermis hypoplasia."〔译：先证者脑 MRI 示典型磨牙征与小脑蚓部发育不良。〕；path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics—Brain Anomalies」，GeneReviews Joubert Syndrome and Related Disorders，PMID 20301500）：“Hypoplasia of the vermis (the midline portion of the cerebellum)”〔译：小脑蚓部（小脑中线部分）发育不良。〕（磨牙征 MRI 表现列表项）；另（同章 Genetic Counseling—Prenatal Testing and Preimplantation Genetic Testing）：“When detection of cerebellar vermis hypoplasia by routine prenatal ultrasound examination raises the possibility of JS, fetal MRI may detect the typical molar tooth sign (MTS); however, the sensitivity and specificity of this prenatal finding remain unknown [Doherty et al 2005, Quarello et al 2014, Bachmann-Gagescu et al 2020, Yen 2024].”〔译：当常规产前超声检出小脑蚓部发育不良提示 JS 可能时，胎儿 MRI 可检出具特征性磨牙征（MTS）；但该产前征象的敏感度与特异度仍未知。〕path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 34359301（2021，39 岁男性、双等位 MKS1 无义变异 JBTS），摘要及全文 PMC8303764）：“Brain magnetic resonance imaging revealed malformations of the posterior cranial fossa with the 'molar tooth sign' and cerebellar folia dysplasia, which are both distinctive features of JBTS.”〔译：脑 MRI 显示颅后窝畸形伴「磨牙征」与小脑叶片发育不良——均为 JBTS 的特征性表现。〕〔模态：MRI；物种：人；n=1〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 41258294，摘要）：“MT-ATP6 mitochondrial diseases are a group of disorders inherited from the maternal lineage caused by pathogenic variants in the MT-ATP6 gene, which encodes the a subunit of mitochondrial complex V…”〔译：MT-ATP6 线粒体病是母系遗传的一组疾病，由 MT-ATP6 基因致病变异引起；该基因编码线粒体复合体 V 的 a 亚基……〕
