evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（PMID 40004480，摘要）：“Sialidosis is a rare autosomal recessive lysosomal storage disorder caused by mutations in the NEU1 gene, resulting in deficient neuraminidase-1 activity and the subsequent accumulation of sialylated compounds in lysosomes.”〔译：唾液酸贮积症是罕见的常染色体隐性溶酶体贮积病，由 NEU1 基因突变引起，导致神经氨酸酶 1 活性缺陷及唾液酸化化合物在溶酶体中蓄积。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 32752208；PMC7465165 Results，全文）：“All of our patients showed cerebellar atrophy, mostly affecting the vermis, which seemed to be progressively in line with the cerebellar clinical symptoms.”〔译：我们所有患者均显示小脑萎缩，多累及蚓部，且似与小脑临床症状的进展相平行。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（提供文献人工核对）：GeneReviews NBK1296「Summary」：“Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC) is a slowly progressive lysosomal disorder” ；Table A：NPC1 = NPC intracellular cholesterol transporter 1〔译：C 型 Niemann-Pick 病（NPC）是缓慢进展的溶酶体病；NPC1 即 NPC 细胞内胆固醇转运体 1。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（补证 GeneReviews NBK1296「Imaging」）：“MRI of the brain is usually normal until the late stages of the illness, when marked atrophy of the superior/anterior cerebellar vermis, thinning of the corpus callosum, and mild cerebral atrophy may be seen.”〔译：脑 MRI 在晚期前通常正常，晚期可见小脑上/前蚓部显著萎缩、胼胝体变薄及轻度大脑萎缩。〕

evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（提供文献人工核对）：同上「Imaging」：“marked atrophy of the superior/anterior cerebellar vermis, thinning of the corpus callosum, and mild cerebral atrophy may be seen”〔译：可见小脑上/前蚓部显著萎缩、胼胝体变薄及轻度大脑萎缩。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（UniProt O14802，Function）："Catalytic core component of RNA polymerase III (Pol III), a DNA-dependent RNA polymerase which synthesizes small non-coding RNAs using the four ribonucleoside triphosphates as substrates."〔译：RNA 聚合酶 III（Pol III）催化核心组分——Pol III 以四种核糖核苷三磷酸为底物合成小非编码 RNA（tRNA、5S rRNA、snRNA 等）；POLR3A 正常转录功能。〕；疾病模型补充（原引，PMID 30898877）：“Transcriptomic profiling uncovered a subset of transcripts vulnerable to Pol III hypofunction, including a global reduction in tRNA levels.”〔译：转录组分析揭示了一组对 Pol III 功能低下敏感的转录本，其中包括 tRNA 水平的整体下降。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（Bookshelf_NBK99167「Diagnosis—Suggestive Findings—Brain MRI findings」，GeneReviews POLR3-Related Leukodystrophy，PMID 22855961）：“A hypomyelinating leukodystrophy pattern characterized by T2 mild hyperintensity of the white matter and T1 hyperintensity, isointensity, or mild hypointensity of the white matter when compared with grey matter structures”〔译：低髓鞘化白质脑病模式：白质 T2 轻度高信号，T1 相对灰质呈高信号、等信号或轻度低信号。〕；另（同文/同章）：“Relative preservation of myelination of specific brain structures, i.e. T2 hypointense signal (normal or almost normal white matter signal) of the dentate nuclei, anterolateral nuclei of the thalami, globi pallidi, pyramidal tracts in the posterior limbs of the internal capsules, and optic radiations”〔译：特定脑结构髓鞘化相对保留，即齿状核、丘脑腹前外侧核、苍白球、内囊后肢锥体束及视辐射呈 T2 低信号（正常或接近正常白质信号）。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·proteostasis_RNA（PMID 30898877；PMC6509492 Introduction，全文）：“POLR3A and POLR3B are the two largest subunits of Pol III and form the active center of the enzyme”〔译：POLR3A 与 POLR3B 是 Pol III 的两个最大亚基，构成该酶的活性中心。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 21559181；PMC3213392（POLR3 低髓鞘化综合征基因分型原始研究，4 名患者中 3 名 POLR3B 突变），Results，全文）："MRI revealed high-intensity areas in the white matter in T2-weighted images, cerebellar atrophy, and a hypoplastic corpus callosum in all four individuals."〔译：MRI 显示全部 4 名个体 T2 加权像白质高信号、小脑萎缩及胼胝体发育不全。〕〔注：原引 PMID 22855961 为「典型临床+MRI+基因检测综合诊断」的定义句，不含任何患者白质实际影像所见，不构成病理 token 证据——已按外部核验意见更换；本句经 PMC 全文逐字核验，POLR3B 特异患者 3 名。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·channel_synapse PMID 41623181：“SCN8A encodes the voltage-gated sodium channel Nav1.6, which plays a key role in facilitating neuronal excitability.”〔译：SCN8A 编码电压门控钠通道 Nav1.6，在促进神经元兴奋性中起关键作用。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（GeneReviews NBK379665「SCN8A-DEE」节，二次权威来源）“Brain MRI is usually normal at the onset of seizures; however, some individuals may have MRI abnormalities including cerebral atrophy and hypoplasia of the corpus callosum.”“Some affected individuals have been shown to develop cerebral or cerebellar atrophy in follow-up studies.”〔译：癫痫起病时脑 MRI 多正常，但部分患者可见大脑萎缩与胼胝体发育不良；随访中部分患者出现大脑或小脑萎缩。〕另 PMID 30171078（22 例）“Brain MRI showed progressive parenchymal atrophy and restriction of the optic radiations”〔译：脑 MRI 见进行性实质萎缩及视辐射受限，未单列小脑〕；PMID 41573391（SCN8A n=7）萎缩 28.6%（未细分脑/小脑）。按 A 级“GeneReviews 明确陈述”采纳——原文为复数患者（some individuals），但未给具体计数

evidence_mech_h: mech·cytoskeleton_transport_glia（PMID 32913944，摘要）：“Glut1 deficiency syndrome (Glut1DS) is a brain energy failure syndrome caused by impaired glucose transport across brain tissue barriers.”〔译：Glut1 缺乏综合征（Glut1DS）是一种脑能量衰竭综合征，由跨脑组织屏障的葡萄糖转运受损所致。〕; GeneReviews明确将GLUT1缺乏综合征描述为脑能量代谢疾病，其核心缺陷是葡萄糖无法充分通过血脑屏障
evidence_path_h: 脑葡萄糖供能不足；缺乏统一的特异性小脑组织病理证据

evidence_mech_h: mech·other（UniProt O95932，Function）："Catalyzes the cross-linking of proteins and the conjugation of polyamines to proteins."〔译：催化蛋白交联及多胺与蛋白的偶联——TG6 正常转谷氨酰胺酶交联功能。〕；突变体实验另记（PMID 28934387）：突变 TG6 在核周区异常蓄积并激活未折叠蛋白反应（UPR）——属突变体的细胞效应。
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 25253745，摘要）：“Brain MRI reveals diffuse cerebellar atrophy without involvement of the cerebral hemispheres or brainstem.”〔译：脑 MRI 显示弥漫性小脑萎缩，未累及大脑半球或脑干。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cilia_congenital_dev（K 为正常蛋白功能分箱；本行 TMEM216—JBTS2）：【疾病特异机制轴】Joubert 综合征是遗传性纤毛病：致病变异影响原发纤毛的组装、过渡区门控或纤毛信号（SHH 等），导致脑干与小脑神经发育异常，临床出现磨牙征、小脑蚓部发育不良、婴儿期低张力及随年龄出现的共济失调。【收录定位】本行属Ⅱ类综合征性/先天性共济失调——共济失调是公认的重要临床组成而非唯一主症，按广覆盖目标收录。【本基因特异定位】属已确立的 Joubert/纤毛病致病基因；本表未检索到该基因特异的直接功能实验，由基因到纤毛表型的中介环节尚未完全阐明，不以综合征共性冒充本基因的独立机制证明。【证据层级】下列 GeneReviews NBK1325 临床定义仅作综合征共性背景，不是本基因的分子机制实验：GeneReviews NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics」：Joubert syndrome (JS) is, with rare exceptions, an autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder defined by a characteristic cerebellar and brain stem malformation；同节另述 “Cerebellar vermis hypoplasia in addition to other distinctive JS/ciliopathy features”〔译：Joubert 综合征除极少数例外，均为常染色体隐性神经发育障碍，以特征性小脑与脑干畸形为定义；该节另述小脑蚓部发育不良及 JS/纤毛病其他特征。〕；基因特异功能（UniProt Q9P0N5，Function）："Essential for primary ciliogenesis and embryonic development, facilitating the activation of Hedgehog (Hh) signaling pathway."〔译：为初级纤毛发生与胚胎发育所必需，促进 Hedgehog（Hh）信号通路的激活。〕〔注：UniProt 权威条目功能描述仅作 K 列正常蛋白功能分箱依据，非已证致病机制。〕
evidence_path_h: path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（PMID 20036350（TMEM216/JBTS2 原始研究，13 名患者/8 个 Ashkenazi Jewish 家系），Results，摘要）："Using homozygosity mapping in 13 patients from eight Ashkenazi Jewish families, we identified a homozygous mutation, R12L, in the TMEM216 gene, in all affected individuals."及"Brain MRI results show cerebellar vermis hypoplasia and additional anomalies of the fourth ventricle, corpus callosum, and occipital cortex."〔译：经纯合定位在 8 个阿什肯纳兹犹太家系 13 名患者中鉴定 TMEM16 纯合突变 R12L，见于全部受累个体；脑 MRI 示小脑蚓部发育不良及第四脑室、胼胝体、枕叶皮层附加异常。〕〔注：摘要经 EuropePMC 逐字抓取核验；原 NBK1325 泛 JS 句降为背景。〕；path·vermis_hypoplasia_molar_tooth（Bookshelf_NBK1325「Clinical Characteristics—Brain Anomalies」，GeneReviews Joubert Syndrome and Related Disorders，PMID 20301500）：“Hypoplasia of the vermis (the midline portion of the cerebellum)”〔译：小脑蚓部（小脑中线部分）发育不良。〕（磨牙征 MRI 表现列表项）；另（同章 Genetic Counseling—Prenatal Testing and Preimplantation Genetic Testing）：“When detection of cerebellar vermis hypoplasia by routine prenatal ultrasound examination raises the possibility of JS, fetal MRI may detect the typical molar tooth sign (MTS); however, the sensitivity and specificity of this prenatal finding remain unknown [Doherty et al 2005, Quarello et al 2014, Bachmann-Gagescu et al 2020, Yen 2024].”〔译：当常规产前超声检出小脑蚓部发育不良提示 JS 可能时，胎儿 MRI 可检出具特征性磨牙征（MTS）；但该产前征象的敏感度与特异度仍未知。〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·dna_repair（UniProt Q9NSU2，Function）："Major cellular 3'-to-5' DNA exonuclease which digests single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) and double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) with mismatched 3' termini. Prevents cell-intrinsic initiation of autoimmunity."〔译：细胞主要的 3'-5' DNA 外切酶，降解单链及 3' 末端错配的双链 DNA，阻止细胞内在自身免疫的启动——TREX1 正常 DNA 外切酶功能。〕〔注：原引 PMID 19525956 为疾病背景句，已换正常功能句。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 26581299（AGS 121 例基因分型影像研究），Results，摘要）："Severe calcification was associated with TREX1 mutations and early age at onset."及"White matter rarefaction was found in 54 subjects (50.0%), strongly associated with mutations in TREX1 and an early age at onset."〔译：严重钙化与 TREX1 突变及早发起病相关；白质稀疏见于 54 例（50.0%），与 TREX1 突变及早发起病强相关。〕〔注：经 PubMed 摘要逐字核验；泛 AGS 诊断背景句（20301648）降为背景。〕；path·white_matter（PMID 20301648，摘要）：“…in a proband with typical clinical findings and characteristic abnormalities on cranial CT (calcification of the basal ganglia and white matter) and MRI (leukodystrophic changes); AND/OR by identification of one of the following: Biallelic pathogenic variants in ADAR, RNASEH2A, RNASEH2B, RNASEH2C, SAMHD1, or TREX1.”〔译：……先证者具典型临床表现及颅脑 CT（基底节与白质钙化）与 MRI（白质营养不良样改变）的特征性异常；和/或检出以下之一：双等位致病变异……〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·mito_metabolic（UniProt Q6DKK2，Function）："Required for the preservation of the structural and functional integrity of mitochondrial respiratory complex III by allowing the physiological turnover of the Rieske protein UQCRFS1."〔译：通过允许 Rieske 蛋白 UQCRFS1 的生理性更新，维持线粒体呼吸链复合物 III 的结构与功能完整性——TTC19 正常功能。〕〔注：原引 PMID 25887401 句「TTC19 缺乏与复合物 III 缺陷有关」属疾病后果，降为补充；该摘要将 TTC19 误写为「TT19」（原文排字错误），如引用须标 [sic]。〕
evidence_path_h: path·cerebellar_atrophy（PMID 25887401（2015 TTC19 原始研究），摘要）：“Neuroimaging of the severely affected patients demonstrated lesions in putamen and caudate nuclei, cerebellar atrophy, and the unusual finding of hypertrophic olivary nuclei degeneration.”〔译：重症受累患者的神经影像显示壳核与尾状核病灶、小脑萎缩及肥厚性下橄榄核变性。〕；分母明确（PMC4422538 全文）：作者队列 4 例——患者 1-3（重症）MRI 均见小脑萎缩，患者 4 为早期征象：“our severely affected patients 1, 2, and 3 showed hypertrophic olivary degeneration at the progressive state of the disease”〔译：我们的重症患者 1、2、3 在进展期显示肥厚性下橄榄核变性（同文各例 MRI 均示小脑萎缩）。〕；患者 1 逐例 MRI：“MR imaging at the age of 4 years showed a rapid progression with bilateral signal hyperintensities in T2-weighted images of the basal ganglia (putamen, pallidum), thalamus, the mesencephalon, and the medulla oblongata with hypertrophic olivary degeneration as well as severe cerebellar atrophy (Figure 2 , column 1).”〔译：4 岁时 MRI 示双侧基底节（壳核、苍白球）、丘脑、中脑、延髓 T2 高信号快速进展，伴肥厚性下橄榄核变性及严重小脑萎缩。〕；患者 3 逐例 MRI：“MR imaging revealed inhomogenous hyperintensities of the striatum (caput nuclei caudate, putamen), hyperintense hypertrophic degeneration of the right inferior olivary nucleus, and cerebellar atrophy (Figure 2 , column 3).”〔译：MRI 示纹状体不均一高信号、右下橄榄核肥厚性变性及小脑萎缩。〕；文献汇总 14 例：“Figure 4 summarizes the major clinical, biochemical, and neuroimaging features of 14 TTC19 patients reported so far”〔译：图 4 汇总迄今报告的 14 例 TTC19 患者的主要临床、生化与神经影像特征。〕〔模态：MRI；物种：人；作者队列 n=4（患者 1-3 小脑萎缩阳性、患者 4 早期征象），文献累计 n=14〕

evidence_mech_h: mech·cytoskeleton_transport_glia（UniProt P04350，Function）："Tubulin is the major constituent of microtubules, a cylinder consisting of laterally associated linear protofilaments composed of alpha- and beta-tubulin heterodimers."〔译：微管蛋白是微管的主要组分——微管由 α/β 微管蛋白异二聚体组成的原丝侧向聚合而成；TUBB4A 即 β-tubulin，为微管核心结构组分（正常细胞骨架功能）。〕
evidence_path_h: path·white_matter（PMID 24785942（Hamilton 等 Brain 2014，H-ABC 42 例），Results（摘要），全文）："The patients’ magnetic resonance images showed an absent or disappearing putamen, variable cerebellar atrophy and highly variable cerebral atrophy. Apart from hypomyelination, myelin loss was evident in several cases."〔译：患者磁共振图像显示壳核缺失或消失、不同程度小脑萎缩及高度可变的大脑萎缩；除低髓鞘化外，多例尚见明显髓鞘丢失。〕〔注：原 O 英文仅残存 "The patients’ " 两词而译文完整——引文残缺已修复；两句经本地 PMC 全文逐字断言（normalize 后子串命中）；白质低髓鞘化由第二句直接支撑。〕
